programme.title: Hunted Australia S3 E10 / 潛行追蹤 澳洲篇 第10集
programme.desc: Season 3 of Australia’s real-life extreme version of hide and seek returns with an intense twist in the form of a large-scale heist. Nine pairs of ordinary Australians turn into shrewd Fugitives, starting with a robbery that’ll see them stealth their way into Ballarat bank to steal up to $1 million dollars, before making their getaway to disappear without a trace. The goal is to make it to the extraction point in 20 days, all while evading capture from the Hunters, a team of some of the best investigators formally of the AFP, ADF, and British Intelligence, as well as special operations and cyber security experts. The Hunters will stop at nothing to outthink, outsmart, and outrun those striving to escape.

programme.title: Billy and Dom Eat the World E12 -Manchester Part 2 / 哈比人食遍世界 第12集 - Manchester Part 2
programme.desc: Best friends on-screen and off, Billy Boyd and Dominic Monaghan, famed for portraying the lovable and mischievous hobbits in The Lord of the Rings trilogy, are embarking on a quest to eat the world. They’ll be travelling the globe to gain new insights into different countries unique culinary cultures, trying local cuisines, and getting up to plenty of shenanigans.

programme.title: News Cast at 6 with Sign Language / 6點新聞報道 (手語新聞)
Now Forum E1029 -嘉賓：羅淑佩 (文化體育及旅遊局局長) / 題目：盛事經濟與文藝發展 / 大鳴大放 第1029集 - 嘉賓：羅淑佩 (文化體育及旅遊局局長) / 題目：盛事經濟與文藝發展
programme.desc: 由黃金周、萬聖月到美酒佳餚等連環盛事活動，訪港旅客人頭湧湧，文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩接受《大鳴大放》專訪時表示，預計全年訪港旅客5380萬，由一月至十月，旅客人數達到4580萬，同比去年同期，升幅達百分之十二，她有信心達標。羅淑佩指迎接年底的旅遊旺季，相信旅客數據繼續上升：「還有11月、12月，都是我們傳統的大旺季，要做到全年增幅百分之八，我的信心是大的。」她續指旅客消費現在是1110億元，相比去年增加百分之十一，符合預期，她希望天氣清涼一點可再帶動消費。羅淑佩表示有酒店高層已告知她尖東一帶酒店現在的入住率，已達百分之九十二、三，預期到聖誕節、新年時酒店的入住率會更高。她又預告今年跨年倒數活動一定會有維港煙花匯演：「一定會盛大，因為我們維港煙花在倒數來說，我們通常做的跨度比較闊，反而農曆新年、國慶煙花，會比較集中在尖沙咀、灣仔一帶；因為做倒數，我們希望可以有一個漂亮的視覺效果，希望香港是足夠去令我們在全世界佔一席位。」至於近日政府提出改革藝團資助制度，新制下五成資助額與KPI掛鈎，包括入座率、贊助收益等，有質疑會否造成受歡迎的劇團「富者越富」，羅淑佩表示不認同：「為甚麼有這個想法呢?受歡迎就繼續受歡迎，我不受歡迎，我就不會再受歡迎了，所以納税人應該要繼續資助我們，雖然我們不受歡歡迎，會不會太過悲觀了！」羅淑佩指改革資助制度，入座率是其中一個重要指標，但尚有其他指標，包括藝團外出表演或回內地演出，另外在推廣教育工作，與海外、海內的藝團交流等，都會是一些量化指標。羅淑佩表示新資助制度重量亦重質，藝術諮詢委員會將會與每一個藝團訂定一套KPI，該套KPI不是將不同的藝團作比較，而是衡量每一個藝團，由其過往至今，有沒有越做越好：「是你自己和自己比較，能不能夠所謂突破自己。」

programme.desc: 熊輝小時候偷看爸爸熊海在書房畫山水畫，有一次，他看見畫中留白，忍不住偷偷添上一塊石頭。那個細微的舉動，後來成了他創作路上的伏筆。長大後，熊輝承接了父親的水墨根基，卻沒有成為第二個熊海。他用更當代、更個人的方式重新演繹傳統，邀請父親一起合作，把父子關係從日常延伸到作品之中。兩人用不同的筆墨語言，繼續守護同一份水墨精神。

Now Forum E1030 -嘉賓：孫玉菡 (勞工及福利局局長) / 題目：工作假期與勞工權益 / 大鳴大放 第1030集 - 嘉賓：孫玉菡 (勞工及福利局局長) / 題目：工作假期與勞工權益
programme.desc: APEC領導人非正式會議在深圳舉行期間，勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡與智利簽署工作假期計劃協議，雙方每年各有100個名額逗留最多一年。孫玉菡在本台節目《大鳴大放》稱，預計明年較早時間開始推行該計劃。勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡：「簽了協議後都要等一等，因為通常都是這樣，雙方會再做一次交換信件，確定何時正式推行。我們現時跟對方商討都是預計明年就能推行，盡可能爭取在明年早一些時間推行。這些工作假期，我們想再開拓多些途徑，讓香港年輕人或智利有興趣來港，參與工作假期就有這機會，從來沒做過南美的，所以多了個選擇。」至於近日討論外賣平台工作者的工傷補償機制，勞福局初步框架未涵蓋「候單」及「搶單」的時間。孫玉菡表示，外賣平台工作者和一般僱員不同的是，他不是長時間與平台之間有合作關係，只有工作者由接了單，送貨或送餐期間才與外賣平台有關係，所以現在定義外賣工作者由接單開始計算，一直到他送完食物，再回來駕車這段期間是受到保障的。孫玉菡續指外賣平台工作者補償機制覆蓋到因工傷停工的補償，並以三級制釐定工傷病假錢，最高可拿到一年工傷病假錢的保障。

programme.desc: Lester兼具民俗音樂及紋身創作的多重身份。他曾任獨立樂隊「觸執毛」的吉他手，並在設計領域追求美學。多年來，他在藝術界的努力使他成為專業創作者，並深受素食和修佛理念的啟發，使創作更具意義。近年，他專注於民俗音樂的研究，透過樂器及表演形式深化自我成長，並以此組建樂隊「I is one」，曾在Clockenflap表演，結合修行與哲理元素。此外，他創立了素食餐廳「余地」，寓意生活中的選擇，倡導以簡單方式將素食與生活結合，Lester相信，藝術的價值在於實踐，而非高深的理論，展現了他對藝術和生活的熱誠。

programme.title: Namib E10 / 我的明星製作人 第10集
programme.desc: 振宇成功登台演唱，但因演唱了一首未經同意的歌曲而被淘汰。即使被淘汰，振宇的歌聲仍成為人們熱議的話題，因此 TA 娛樂公司聯絡秀賢，希望買下他。

programme.title: foodpanda Presents: Bonus Leveling E4 -GAME 3 《躲藏與搜索》 / 輪盤遊戲 第4集 - GAME 3 《躲藏與搜索》
programme.desc: 8位玩家躲藏於傢俬店內，躲避搜索者的地毯式搜索，為了能夠成功避開搜索者的法眼，更有玩家不惜犧牲色相，換上特別裝扮，究竟誰可藏到最後？

programme.title: UA Finance Presents: The Making of Long Vacation: Starting Over E10 / 悠長假期 重新出發 第10集
WeWa Card Presents: Late Night Foodie E5 / 收夜的美食家 第5集
programme.desc: 「宵夜係自願，收夜係被迫」 疫情後，相信全港打工仔都面對同一問題，一但OT收夜，在市面還有甚麼餐廳可以光顧？ 「宵夜」係你食飽之後的飯後甜品，「收夜」係捱完OT之後但咩都未食的人間悲劇。 為回應市民訴求，Jacky, Arvin 化身「收夜的美食家」，走訪香港各區晚上9點後依然熱鬧營業的各式餐廳，讓各位觀眾知道即使要OT或收夜，除左連鎖店的漢堡薯條，仲可以選擇中式、日式、美式、韓式，港式飲茶鑊氣小炒通通都有！ Jacky Fan及Arvin曾傲棐除了會介紹這些「收夜」餐廳的美食之外，也會訪問這些小店老闆了解他們的故事之餘，亦有嘉賓好友作為飯腳！ 除「收夜」餐廳美食介紹之外，也會有小環節介紹主持們的神秘食法，讓大家可以快速方便吃到一個有溫度兼好味道的Late Dinner！

programme.title: MIRROR: Today's Agenda E5 / MIRROR今日做緊乜？ 第5集
Talker - One Beside You 3 E466 -靈異學會會長Jacqueline分享靈異經歷 / 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近 第466集 - 靈異學會會長Jacqueline分享靈異經歷
programme.desc: 香港靈異學會會長Jacqueline對靈學非常有研究，當面對近年親友相繼離世，她曾收到逝者托夢向她交代身後事安排，亦試過打破自己一貫做法，以自己熟悉的探靈儀器與剛去世不久的朋友溝通，了解他未了的心事。

programme.title: Love's Ambition (Bilingual) E8 / 許我耀眼 第8集
programme.desc: 沈皓明說服首科地產合作，分析局勢助其升級公司。孫思唯懷疑許妍背景，設局揭穿，卻被許妍識破。許妍憑實力通過競聘，成為財經新聞主播。許妍獲得沈家認可，於嵐對她更加滿意。

programme.title: Lovely Runner (Bilingual) E1 / 背著善宰跑 第1集
programme.desc: 在絕望中，頂級男明星柳善宰是女粉絲任素唯一的精神支柱。但一天突如其來的惡耗──善宰不幸離世，令任素整個世界天翻地覆。一覺醒來卻發現自己回到了13 年前，和當時正值青春燦爛只知道游泳的善宰是同學時，便決心盡力拯救善宰，阻止未來發生的悲劇而孤軍奮戰。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E8 / 7人的復活 第8集
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: Recipe for Love (Bilingual) E2 / 愛情處方箋 第2集
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: The Scarecrow (Bilingual) E9 / 稻草人 第9集
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E9 / 7人的復活 第9集
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: Recipe for Love (Bilingual) E3 / 愛情處方箋 第3集
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: The Scarecrow (Bilingual) E10 / 稻草人 第10集
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。

programme.title: Lovely Runner (Bilingual) E2 / 背著善宰跑 第2集

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E9 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第9集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E9 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第9集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E9 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第9集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space (Bilingual) E9 / 鯖魚罐頭，航向宇宙 第9集
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E10 / 7人的復活 第10集
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: The Scarecrow (Bilingual) E11 / 稻草人 第11集

programme.title: Lovely Runner (Bilingual) E3 / 背著善宰跑 第3集
programme.desc: 在絕望中，頂級男明星柳善宰是女粉絲任素唯一的精神支柱。但一天突如其來的惡耗──善宰不幸離世，令任素整個世界天翻地覆。一覺醒來卻發現自己回到了13 年前，和當時正值青春燦爛只知道游泳的善宰是同學時，便決心盡力拯救善宰，阻止未來發生的悲劇而孤軍奮戰。

programme.desc: 在絕望中，頂級男明星柳善宰是女粉絲任素唯一的精神支柱。但一天突如其來的惡耗──善宰不幸離世，令任素整個世界天翻地覆。一覺醒來卻發現自己回到了13 年前，和當時正值青春燦爛只知道游泳的善宰是同學時，便決心盡力拯救善宰，阻止未來發生的悲劇而孤軍奮戰。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E11 / 7人的復活 第11集
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇。

programme.title: Recipe for Love (Bilingual) E7 / 愛情處方箋 第7集
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: The Scarecrow (Bilingual) E12 / 稻草人 第12集
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。

programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動。

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince (Bilingual) E21 / 世子消失了 第21集

programme.title: Lovely Runner (Bilingual) E7 / 背著善宰跑 第7集
programme.desc: 在絕望中，頂級男明星柳善宰是女粉絲任素唯一的精神支柱。但一天突如其來的惡耗──善宰不幸離世，令任素整個世界天翻地覆。一覺醒來卻發現自己回到了13 年前，和當時正值青春燦爛只知道游泳的善宰是同學時，便決心盡力拯救善宰，阻止未來發生的悲劇而孤軍奮戰。

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection (Bilingual) E13 / 7人的復活 第13集

programme.title: The Heart 2 E20 / 問心 2 第20集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E12 / 九霄寒夜暖 第12集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E35 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第35集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E3 / 誰是兇手 第3集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: Eight Hundred E14 / 方圓八百米 第14集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E17 / 問心 2 第17集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire E7 / 披荊斬棘的大小姐 第7集
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E36 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第36集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E4 / 誰是兇手 第4集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: Master of My Own E1 / 請叫我總監 第1集
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E22 / 問心 2 第22集

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E14 / 九霄寒夜暖 第14集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E5 / 誰是兇手 第5集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: Master of My Own E1 / 請叫我總監 第1集
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: OOPS!I'M IN JAIL E1 / 監所男子囚生記 第1集
programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E23 / 問心 2 第23集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Master of My Own E2 / 請叫我總監 第2集
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.desc: 一個厭世新鮮人意外進入監獄成為管理員，同時監獄也有一群迫不得已在此工作的夥伴，每天面臨各種光怪陸離的遭遇。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E24 / 問心 2 第24集

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night E16 / 九霄寒夜暖 第16集
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Master of My Own E3 / 請叫我總監 第3集
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

programme.title: Master of My Own E4 / 請叫我總監 第4集
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: Who is the Murderer E8 / 誰是兇手 第8集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16 E44 -十幾年的緣分沒走到最後 / 非誠勿擾 第16季 第44集 - 十幾年的緣分沒走到最後
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4 E83 / 緣來不晚 第4季 第83集
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 3 E9 -全員體驗中醫美容 / 國醫少年志 第3季 第9集 - 全員體驗中醫美容
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E35 / 遊遍江蘇 第4季 第35集

programme.title: Rap Star Dream Maker (Repackaged) E10 -十強集結完成 / 說唱夢工廠 第10集 - 十強集結完成
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix (Mini drama) E13 / 迎鳳歸 (短劇) 第13集
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E62 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第62集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E64 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第64集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: Chinese Tunic Suit E2 / 中山裝 第2集
programme.desc: 從廣東中山出發，一路向北，沿著廣州、武漢、寧波、上海、北京等孫中山先生曾經的足跡，追溯中山裝的起源，記錄中山裝行業今天的發展、機遇與選擇。

programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: Her Prime Season 2 E14 -小鹿湯包給未來孩子寫信 / 姐姐當家 第2季 第14集 - 小鹿湯包給未來孩子寫信

programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣。

programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: Aces vs Aces Season 8 (Repackaged) E11 -王牌荒島生存大賽 / 王牌對王牌 第八季 第11集 - 王牌荒島生存大賽
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂！

programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Wander Together E3 -攜手踏上茶馬古道 / 宇宙閃爍請注意 第3集 - 攜手踏上茶馬古道
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號。

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix (Mini drama) E19 / 迎鳳歸 (短劇) 第19集
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E68 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第68集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: Ready To Dance Season 2 E6 -Battle突圍賽來襲 / 開始跳舞吧 第2季 第6集 - Battle突圍賽來襲
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合。

programme.title: Crush of Music Season 3 (Live) E4[Live] / 音樂緣計劃 第3季 第4集
programme.desc: 延續歌手與原創音樂人「雙向奔赴」的核心模式，通過歌曲爭奪與舞台首演挖掘華語樂壇新生力量；嘉賓包括容祖兒、周深、劉宇寧、黃子弘凡、希林娜依·高、于文文等；以「緣」為紐帶，讓實力唱將與原創作品相遇，打造兼具競技懸念與音樂品質的視聽盛宴。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E37 / 遊遍江蘇 第4季 第37集
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Weeds on Fire / 點五步
programme.desc: In the year of 1984, 'Shatin Martins', the first Hong Kong youth baseball team, was formed. The 10 young players were living an uneasy and restless life as Hong Kong was being humiliated by one defeat after another and the fate of the 'Shatin Martins'...

programme.title: Hong Kong Family / 過時．過節
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: Golden Chicken / 金雞
programme.desc: It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.

programme.title: Blind Detective / 盲探
programme.desc: The crime-solver in the Police Crime Unit CHONG was forced to quit four years ago after he got blind accidentally and since then has worked as a private eye on cold cases to earn rewards for a living. He has spent nine months investigating the suspect for the Mongkok Acid Attack Case but was caught in a dire situation during an operation. Fortunately he was saved by a woman detective TUNG in the nick of time...

programme.title: Happy End / 快樂到死
programme.desc: Bora Choi, who works at an English language institute, is having an affair with her ex-lover, Il-Beom Kim. Her husband, Min-ki Seo, is a former banker. He has lost his job, and has taken over the domestic roles of the house: cooking, cleaning, and watching the baby. In his free time, he watches soap operas and reads romance novels. Min-ki is aware of the affair, but seems willing to put up with it and to continue living with his cheating wife. Bora is disturbed when Il-Beom seems to want to take their affair further and pushes past her boundaries, risking to expose their relationship.

programme.title: All You Need is Love / 總是有愛在隔離
programme.desc: On a quiet and peaceful afternoon, the Hong Kong Grande Hotel suddenly becomes the center of attention when it is suspected to be the epicenter of the coronavirus outbreak. The Center for Disease Control orders the hotel to be sealed, forcing its guests to undergo a mandatory 14-day quarantine. However, being isolated from the world ends up bringing the quarantined people together in unexpected ways. As they bond over this difficult time, they learn to treasure what may be their final moments together.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2020 / 家有囍事2020
programme.desc: The Yau's brothers are a trio of scammers who make punishing baddies their mission. A misunderstanding leads them to fellow con artists the Lui's sisters, and they join hands to scam a notorious mob boss. Through a myriad of ingenious tricks and disguises, they bring the mobster to justice as romance blossoms swiftly...

programme.title: Finding Mr. Right / 北京遇上西雅圖
programme.desc: Jiajia goes to Seattle to give birth to the son who's going to help her win over her rich, married boyfriend. But when the city nothing goes right...

programme.title: As It Burns / 白晝如焚
programme.desc: An explosion takes place in an apartment late at night, detective Ngai Wan arrives for the investigation and a charred woman body found on spot, her name is Yin Ching. Ching is getting married with Ng Lam who grew up in a wealthy family. Though it seems to be an accident, Wan feels that something is unusual. Wan first investigate the background of Ching and finds that her mother was died in a fire accident fifteen years ago also. Before that, Ching and her mother were in a difficult relationship, Lo Chi Fung was the only person Ching could talk to. They both grew up in Pak Sin Town and disappeared together after the accident happened. Wan perseveres in the investigation but the case just like falling into the mist as everyone related to Ching are all hiding some secrets. The turning point comes out until Lo Chi Fung and his girlfriend Lam Yam show up. The two fatal cases are crossing fifteen years, everyone can be suspected. The truth is far beyond everyone's imagination behi

programme.title: Good Deal / 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c

programme.title: Three / 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret...

programme.title: Dust to Dust / 第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: In 1995, a large armed robbery occurred in Guangdong. A bank cash truck was robbed by five armed robbers, causing a loss of $15 million and three bank's escorts were killed. The incident shocked the whole country, the Police immediately set up a task force, led by Wang Shouyue and He Lan, and quickly found the whereabouts of the five robbers, except the real mastermind behind the case, the owner of a construction company, Chen Xinwen, and his cousin Chen Xinnian.Chen Xinwen and Chen Xinnian embarked on the road to escape, and has since evaporated. Twenty-one years later, the case has long faded from the public, and Wang Shouyue also retired. However, a usual video with a blurred figure rekindled his hope of solving the case...

programme.title: Back to the Past / 尋秦記
programme.desc: A wrongful imprisonment leads to a crisis that can change the course of history! To make up for his wrongful imprisonment, Ken vows to travel to the Qin dynasty and become the Qin Emperor. Meanwhile, in the Qin Dynasty, Hong Siu-lung and his family have spent the last two decades in seclusion, but his every move is still being watched by his disciple, the Qin Emperor. Just as the emperor is on the cusp of ultimate power after conquering the six rival warring states, he is ambushed by Ken and his team. With nowhere else to go, he turns to Hong, the mentor that he both reveres and fears, for safety, reuniting them for the first time in 20 years. As Ken binds these men's fate once more, the emperor and Hong's long-standing grudge must be settled once and for all.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Frontline of Cold War / 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s......

programme.title: All Shall Be Well / 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family...

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2 / 金雞2
programme.desc: Set in the year 2046, 82-year-old Golden Chicken Ah Gum spots a heartbroken man planning to take memory loss-pills. She begins to recap her life story starting in 2003.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E287 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第287集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Breaking Ice / 燃冬
programme.desc: In cold wintry Yanji in Dongbei, visiting urbanite Haofeng feels lost and adrift. By chance, he meets Nana, a tour guide who instantly fascinates him. She introduces him to Xiao, a personable but frustrated restaurant worker. The trio bond quickly over a drunken weekend, fueled by a bit of lust. Confronting their individual traumas, their frozen desires slowly thaw as they seek to liberate themselves from an icy world.

programme.title: The Mole Song -Undercover Agent Reiji- FINAL / 臥底型警 FINAL
programme.desc: Reiji Kikukawa graduated from the police academy with the worst record in its history. One day out of the blue, this straightforward, overly hot-blooded cop with a weakness for women is assigned to an undercover investigation as “The Mole”! He is ordered to infiltrate Japan's most feared yakuza organization in order to arrest its leader, Shuho Todoroki. Reiji goes deep undercover and his final mission is to stop the biggest illegal drug trade in history worth USD 6 billion which takes place on a luxury cruise ship sailing around the world!

programme.title: The Rising Star -Renci Yeung / 我要做接班人 -楊偲泳
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: The Whistleblower / 吹哨人
programme.desc: An earthquake of 6.6 magnitude strikes Malawi in southeast Africa. Eco Energy Technology, an Australian energy conglomerate with business in the region, sends its rescue team for emergency response. Meanwhile, in an exclusive resort in Australia, expatriate Mark (Lei Jiayin) runs into his ex-lover Wen (Tang Wei), now married to the chairman of Han Coal Group. Their old feelings rush back but soon he is dragged into something bigger with Wen... and turn into a night of passion, before Wen flies off to China in the morning. That afternoon, Mark is devastated to learn that the plane Wen took has crashed, with no sign of survivors. Two weeks have passed. Mark is trying to leave the past behind, when a mysterious call puts him in limbo. Mark discovers Wen cheats death after failing to catch the flight. Before figuring out the next step, they are tracked down by killers wherever they flee. Someone obviously wants her dead for good. Hopelessly outpowered, Mark pledges to protect Wen

programme.title: Lost In Time / 忘不了
programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong 2013 / 2013我愛HK 恭囍發財
programme.desc: Hong Kong of the 1970s - a place bustling with opportunities and riches! The earnest Sung befriended the crafty Ha and the latter also helped Song found his first job: a waiter at a Teahouse. The boss of the Teahouse is a kind man, who has an array of quirky characters as his staff. The colorful characters attracted an interesting patronage, making it a happening place for the community. Fate has it that both Sung and Ha fell for the same girl: May who is from a well-to-do family. It's face off between the geek and the smooth-talker. While romance is blossoming between May and Song, May's best friend Yuen is a gutsy girl who insisted that bad boys are attractive and only have eyes for Ha. Decades past and Sung weathered many changing times: crash of stock market; era of mass-migration and more... While Sung remained steadfast, guarding the teahouse, continuing to serve his loyal patrons and providing jobs for his long-serving staff, the fast-thinking Ha now owns a business e

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Gigi Leung: The Monkey King 3 / 爆谷巨星匯：梁詠琪: 西遊記之女兒國
programme.desc: On the conflict-packed journey to the West for the scriptures, escorted by Sun, Bajie and Sha, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, accidentally enters the Womanland of Western Liang, a mysterious nation where no men has ever been existed. The Queen falls for Xuanzang at first sight, without knowing what love is, thinking she could be terminally ill with incurable lovesickness. The Preceptor warns her that men are all poisonous creatures and orders to kill Xuanzang and his disciples. With the help of the Queen, the four flee the execution site, but later Xuanzang, Bajie and Sha carelessly drink the water from the Motherhood River that makes them pregnant rapidly. Wukong tries to save the three with his almighty transforming sorcery, when Xuanzang gradually loses his stand to falls in love with the Queen. The trespass of the four outsiders also agitates the God of River Oblivion, who completely breaks the peace of the Womanland. The River God floods the whole nation in a fury and puts i

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Deconstructing the Cold War Universe / 爆谷製造 -拆解寒戰宇宙
programme.desc: Director Longman Leung is here to shed light on the mysteries of the “Cold War” series. What actually does the operation codename “Cold War” mean? Longman reveals that not a single shot had been fired in the first script while the foreshadowing in dialogue of 'Cold War' and 'Cold War 2' are going to be revealed in the sequel! Let's find out more behind-the-scenes stories of the “Cold War” series shared by Longman.

programme.title: Memories / 回憶三部曲
programme.desc: From the creative supervision of Katsuhiro OTOMO ('STEAMBOY', 'SHORT PEACE'), comes 'MEMORIES', a three-part work based on OTOMO's three original stories. ('MAGNETIC ROSE') Set in outer space at the end of the 21st century, the 1st part tells the story of two engineers who encounter the apparition of a female opera singer in an abandoned space freighter... ('STINK BOMB') The 2nd story is a satirical tale of a young lab technician who accidentally swallows experimental pills... ('CANNON FODDER') The 3rd part depicts war-time life in an imaginary world, using a characteristic camerawork.

programme.title: The Floating Landscape / 戀之風景
programme.desc: Mann haunted by the death of her lover, struggles to accept a new life. She goes to Qingdao in search of the landscape that her love spoke of in his final days. There, she meets a young postman Lit who runs along with Mann every day in the landscape search. While Lit gradually falls for Mann's beauty and passion, she can only think of her lost-lover and the painting...

programme.title: Ip Man 3 / 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E287 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第287集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: Resurrection / 爆谷獨家首播: 狂野時代
programme.desc: In a world where humanity has lost the ability to dream, one creature remains entranced by the fading illusions of the dreamworld. This monster, adrift in reverie, clings to visions no one else can see - until a woman appears. Gifted with the rare power to perceive these illusions for what they truly are, she chooses to enter the monster's dreams, determined to uncover the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen / 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.

programme.title: No Other Choice / 選擇有罪
programme.desc: You Man-su, a specialist in paper manufacturing with 25 years of experience, is so satisfied with life that he can truthfully tell himself, “I've got it all.” While happily passing his days with his wife Miri, their two children and two dogs, Man-su is suddenly informed by his company that he has been fired. “We're sorry. We have no other choice.” Feeling shocked as if his head had been cut off by an ax, Man-su vows to find himself a new job within the next three months for the sake of his family. Despite his firm resolve to turn his life around, Man-su spends over a year drifting from one job interview after another, and working at a retail store. programme.desc: After failing to win the Seoul mayoral election, Joo Sang-sook became an unemployable property and no parties will admit to associating with her in fear of bad press, but when she rescues a young man from drowning, she is suddenly pulled into spotlight and wins the election to become the Gangwon province governor. But her honesty sinks her approval rating and she resorts back to lying through her teeth. As fate would have it, her truth mouth returns! Not only that, her chief of staff Hee-cheol is cursed with the same truth bomb!

programme.title: The White Dragon / 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: The Lyricist Wannabe / 填詞L
programme.desc: Believing that writing Cantopop is her God-given talent, Law Wing-sze decides to make it her lifelong career. But as hard as Sze tries to polish her lyrics writing skills and expand her social circle, nothing seems to go her way. What if there's a will, but there's no way? The first major motion picture about Cantopop lyrics writing. Norris Wong's long-awaited follow-up to her acclaimed debut My Prince Edward is an unsentimental autobiographical dramedy that reminds us no dream is guaranteed to come true. Ironically, the film's star, up-and-coming actress Chung Suet-ying, is actually a real-life Cantopop lyricist.

programme.title: Keep Rolling / 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Dongbei, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalized characters

programme.title: Love Lies / 我談的那場戀愛
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

programme.title: Storms of Change: Under the Light / 風雲變色: 堅如磐石
programme.desc: Su Jianming, the son of Deputy Mayor Zheng Gang of Jinjiang City, defies his father's counsel and attends a cunning dinner invitation from the wealthiest man in Jinjiang City, Li Zhitian. To his astonishment, he becomes an unwilling witness to a shocking incident where someone is coerced into thrusting their hand into a simmering hotpot. As past mysteries resurface, hidden factions from various quarters plot and scheme, employing intricate strategies, scrutiny, and suspicion. Amidst the web of conflicting desires, the pressing question remains: who will ultimately unveil the final mask?

programme.title: Measure in Love / 他年她日
programme.desc: Measure in Love is set in the universe where a massive earthquake has divided the world into Aurora Zone and Evergreen Zone, and the “Wall of Gravity” standing in the middle of the sea distorts time and gravity differently on both sides. One day in Aurora Zone equals one year in Evergreen Zone. When Ann-Jean from the Aurora Zone meets Tato from the Evergreen Zone, can their love break through the irresistible fate of time differences?

programme.title: Mount CHIAK / 異山怪談
programme.desc: Members of 'GO2MOUNTAIN' bike riding club try valleys of Mount CHIAK where unreal too-cleanly-cut mutilation murders happened. Moments of freedom riding the mountain, odd things happen around them. Will they survive through what that haunts?

programme.title: 12 Golden Ducks / 12金鴨
programme.desc: Devastated by a love affair, former in-demand gigolo Future Chang retreats to Thailand. Thanks to the intervention of his high school teacher, Future summons the courage to return...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E275 -Atonement / 爆谷電影現場 第275集 -阿龍
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Atonement / 阿龍
programme.desc: Single father Lung and his daughter Ying are each other's only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand. Lung abandons all his faith. He marries Lan, and starts a new life in Thailand. However, he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost...

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind / 反詐師奶兵團
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Dealer Healer / 毒。誡
programme.desc: This is a true story based on a repented gangster preaching the word of God and guiding his brotherhood to turn over a new leaf. Chen once was the leader of the famous gang “The 13 Tsz Wan Shan”, he lost his family, lovers, brothers and finally ended up imprisoned for his drug abuse and trafficking. After jail, he devoted himself to save the lost fellows and was selected as “The JCI Hong Kong Ten Outstanding Young Persons”. Being respected by the world, Chen is always asked to solve the most difficult situations between evil and good. People give him a nickname “The Fixer”. However, there are two sides of a coin, Chen can work out any problem of others, he does not know how to deal with his personal knot with his love, with whom he has had guilty conscience all his life. Can he fix it eventually?

programme.title: Kung Fu Master Is My Grandma! / 我的婆婆黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Gucci, an ordinary teenage girl grows up in a single-parent family. In order to protect her good friend, she fights with somebody and is sent to girls' home. After release, she knows her mother died in a car accident. So she doesn't have a choice but to live with her weird grandmother, Wong Fei Hung. Gucci does not like Wong's old-fashion and strange character and they always quarrel about some unimportant issues. Gucci has fallen in love with a bartender. However, happy times always can't last, bad luck seems still follow Gucci......

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News / OMG！阿媽有喜
programme.desc: Rita, 53, and her husband Siu Hung were planning their retirement when they suddenly discovered that they were pregnant! Both the couple wanted to have the child removed, but they didn't know how to tell each other. Until at a family dinner, two children accidentally discovered the secret of their mother, and the reaction was uproar. At the same time, Siu Hung's sister-Fuk Ling returned from abroad and decided to move in with everyone. The incompatible relationship between sister-in-law and sister-in-law suddenly plunged the Lee family into a chaotic dispute. In anger, Rita decided to become a senior mother and decided to give birth to the child in her belly. The peaceful and well-off family began an unprecedented 'big reform'. However, during this wonderful pregnancy process, everyone began to become different because of this sudden little life...including Fuk Ling, who had been married for many years but did not want to have children; his otaku son who was not good at expre

programme.title: LOVE RESET / 30日求「分」大作戰
programme.desc: “I was perfect until God threw this woman into my life” JUNG-YEOL, the intelligent and handsome loser. “He's like a mosquito. Who knows why they exist?” NARA, the successful careerwoman born with a side of crazy. Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again. But......with D-30 until they stamp their papers, a fateful accident inflicts amnesia on the star-crossed couple.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E285 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第285集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team / 得寵先生
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in...

programme.title: Labyrinth / 謎攻少女
programme.desc: Shiori, an ordinary high school student, dreams day and night of becoming viral on social media. One day, a crack appears on her smartphone screen and a virtual 'SHIORI' made of data is born. This new-born “SHIORI” not only upending her world but also replacing her real life. Trapped in the digital world, Shiori is powerless to save herself, watching helplessly as her imposter transforms into a vibrant idol and internet celebrity. In this digital Labyrinth, Shiori encounters a mysterious rabbit guy named 'Komori,' who guides her escape this bizarre and algorithm-constructed digital maze. Before herself is completely digitized and forgotten, she must find her way home...

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II / 無間道 II
programme.desc: Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: Storms of Change: Infernal Affairs III / 風雲變色: 終極無間
programme.desc: Ten months after the murder of Yan (Tony Leung), Ming (Andy Lau) is relegated to the backseat of mundane office work, pending internal investigation. Exhausted mentally and physically, Ming is running on empty, but he is convinced that he can reverse his fortune in no time. Meanwhile, a new star has emerged in the police force. Hardly forty years old, Wing (Leon Lai) has already risen to the top echelon thanks to his illustrious track record...

programme.title: Baby Blues / 詭嬰
programme.desc: When blogger Tian Qing and song-writer Hao married, Hao buys an old house, and Tian Qing likes a doll left by the previous owner. From then on, it's as if the doll is always watching the newly weds. Soon, Tian Qing is pregnant with twins. Very unusual since neither Hao nor Tian Qing have a history of twins in their family. But a homeless man who lives at the end of their road isn't happy for them, he even warns them to move out of the house as soon as possible. It's happy news that his wife is pregnant, plus his work is going well because a popular singer wants him to produce her next track. Hao is coming home late, sometimes staying overnight in the studio. So he asks Tian Qing's younger sister, Trinket, to come stay with them to look after his wife...

programme.title: Over My Dead Body / 死屍死時四十四
programme.desc: A dead body and a hotchpotch of homeowners in a residential building on a single night: all hell breaks loose. As the Jewish axiom has it, “man thinks; God laughs.” On a night like any other, Ming, together with his wife and mother-in-law, finds an anonymous naked dead body lying at their doorstep. They might not know who the body was, but they have no doubt that their unit will become a “murder home” once this is exposed. Its property value will nosedive, and they will be transformed from blissful homeowners to miserable victims. So they decide to pass the buck to their neighbours. There are eleven living residents in four units on the same floor. Besides Ming's family of five, there are the retired elderly couple, Mr. & Mrs. Chan; the single lady Mary and her maid; and the Cheung's, an irascible father and his cantankerous son. Last but not least, there is this mysterious woman from an upper floor who chain smokes. This motley group of residents start fighting against one a

programme.title: Exhuma / 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: Throw Down / 柔道龍虎榜
programme.desc: Pub Manager / band leader Sze-to was once the greatest Jodo fighter around until he unexpectedly gave up the sport for no apparent reason. nowadays Sze-to lives the life of an alcoholic gambler with no hope for the future, until cocky Judo enthusiast Tony shows up at the door and challenges Sze-to into a duet, Old Foe Kong demands finishing the match that never took place years ago; Sze-to mentor Master Cheng asks him to manage his rundown Dojo... All of a sudden, Sze-to's pub turns into an arena where the greatest Judo fighters show off their skills.... Sze-to will take on his opponents with everything he's got.

programme.title: One Last Bloom / 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: Lady Cop & Papa Crook / 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil, John Fok.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E299 -The Remnant / 爆谷電影現場 第299集 -惡人當道
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Pilot / 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off?

programme.title: The Warlords / 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang...

programme.title: Thunderstruck Cop / 超能神探
programme.desc: One day, Hyun-joon, a policeman who lives with his mother and his daughter, attains a superpower after getting struck by the lightning. After the incident, Hyun-joon realizes that there are others who have been going through the same situation with him, and gets involved with unexpected situations. Will he be able to succeed both, as a father who struggles with the relationship with his daughter, and as a cop with a superpower who is eager to catch an evil criminal?

programme.title: Kiss My Ass Boss / 他馬克老闆
programme.desc: Based on famous comic series “I'm Mark”, a fantasy comedy about crazy office life is going on the screen! Mark is a wage slave in advertising, working overtime every day. He is so desperate and tries to end this all, then the death god comes. But when the death god is ready to take Mark's life, it claims to leave work and let Mark survive for one more night. Mark grasps the last chance to vandalize the office to end his life without regret. But the following day, the death god finds he has mistaken the wrong target!? In other words, Mark still needs to stay in this mad world. However, Mark gets promoted into a special position and people in the office treat him as a VIP. What will happen when Mark become the boss?

programme.title: Cold War (Director's Cut) / 寒戰 (導演版)
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E285 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第285集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Storms of Change: Death Stranding / 風雲變色: 困獸
programme.desc: The President of Gaming Association blacklisted Wa Sam Group from bidding of gaming concessions on the ground. This blacklisting triggered a series of retaliations from Wa Sam Group. Thus, the Anti-Triad Office immediately set up a special team lead by Lee Shui Ming and he called back Man Fung for help. Fourth Elder's wife Chu Lei received a phone call from her ex-boyfriend Man Fung for a meeting. Kwan Chit, a member of the Gaming Association with the support of Wa Sam Group, also persuaded Man Fung to stop keeping his eyes on them. The two have parted in discord. Kwan Chit remembered the tragic death of his ex-girlfriend Man Kei, sister of Man Fung. He came to Man Fung late at night, the two old friends finally agreed to revenge for their beloved one together.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E300 -Behind the Shadows / 爆谷電影現場 第300集 -私家偵探
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Heart Against Hearts / 三人做世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud...

programme.title: In The Line Of Duty 4 / 皇家師姐IV之直擊証人
programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer...

programme.title: Truant Hero / 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon / 龍的傳人
programme.desc: Hung is a Kung-fu coach on Lautau Island. His son Lung and his fellow schoolmate, Mao, are considered a couple. One time, Hung's fellow Yan goes to Lautau for help. Lung knows Yan is not a good guy, however, Hung orders Lung to accompany with Yan to develop his career in the city. Yan discovers that Lung is a talented snooker-player and earns much money from gambling. But Lung loses Hung's land to a group of gangsters in game...

programme.title: The Legend Of Zu / 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia...

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III / 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao...

programme.title: Fight Back To School III / 逃學威龍三之龍過雞年
programme.desc: The Millionaire, Million Wong, is found dead in a hotelroom. The police head officer, Mr. Ta Wang Lai, orders Chau Sing Sing to be an undercover again for further investigation.

programme.title: Project A / A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics...

programme.title: Project A Part II / A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace...

programme.title: Fly Me To Polaris / 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive?

programme.title: Love is Love / 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage...

programme.title: The Case Of The Cold Fish / 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: The Champions / 「武」績「彪」炳: 波牛
programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on...

programme.title: Tokyo Raiders / 東京攻略
programme.desc: On the marriage day of Macy, her bridegroom Takahashi disappears. She comes to Tokyo to look for him. She meets Tommy, a debt collector and Lenny, a private eye of a gangster boss...

programme.title: Casino Raider 2 / 至尊無上之永霸天下
programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge...

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III / 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: Chit the Kick breaks his leg in the fight with Wong Fey Hong, and is discarded by godfather Chao. Wong nurses him and teams up with him in a martial arts tournament to defeat Chao...

programme.title: The Cat / 衛斯理之老貓
programme.desc: One night, disturbing noise comes from an upstairs flat. Lee Don decides to go up and caution the noise-makers. He sees there are an old man, a young girl and a black cat. But Lee Don discovers that the flat is completely deserted on the next day. A cat's innards, however, are left behind. Lee Don tells this to Wisely, famous for his adventures. Wisely gets suspicious. Finally, the old man and the girl explain to Wisely that they are travelers from outer space marooned on the earth. They are making the machine to go back. An outer space killer takes possession of a police officer's body and tries to wipe them, including Wisely...

programme.title: My Dad Is A Jerk / 對不起，多謝你
programme.desc: Lee Lap Cheong is an immature, irresponsible and gutless guy who does not know how to say 'Sorry' and 'Thank you', a good-for-nothing who has completely given away his pride. When Cheong was still young, he married Yip Ting, who then bore him a son. As Ting grew older, she changed her outlook on life and realized that Cheong's love was not as important as financial security. She divorced Cheong and immigrated to Canada with their son Jason to start a new life...

programme.title: The Champions / 波牛
programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on...

programme.title: July Rhapsody / 男人四十
programme.desc: Secondary school teacher Lam Yiu-kwok is suffering from a mid-life crisis - his peers have all become more successful than him; his relationship with his wife, Chan Man-ching, is in trouble when her old flame returns, and he finds himself tempted by a 17-year-old student who has a crush on him...

programme.title: When East Goes West / 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts...

programme.title: Magic Crystal / 魔翡翠
programme.desc: Archaeologist Shum finds an antique jade with supernatural power in Greece. The stone is wanted both by KGB's agent Karoff and the Interpol. Shum asks his friend Nike (Andy Lau) for help. However, Shum is finally caught by KGB but the jade is slipped into the hands of a boy called Pan. He discovers the crystal is from space and they become friends. While Nike is imputed and jailed, Karoff comes and captures Pan to get the jade......

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Kwan Kam Pang / 影人映語 -關錦鵬
programme.desc: “Rogue”, one of the most significant film of Director Stanley Kwan, earned him the Best Director and made the characters “Fleur” and “Chan Chen-Pang” a legend. He reveals the story behind the film's directorial position and the obstacles he encountered along the production, as well as talking about his delicate sense of portraying women's stories.

programme.title: Love Unto Wastes / 地下情
programme.desc: Billie Yuen and her two friends Liao Yu Ping and Zhao Shu Ling, share the same ideal to become famous. The three women met Tony Cheung who is the son of a rice wholesaler at a bar. Tony was madly clung to the indifferent dressing Billie and then they cohabit. The four friends spent a good night at Liao's home, celebrating her birthday. One night, when Liao came home late, Zhao was found being murdered. Liao was filled with great sorrow. The three friends received Sergeant Lan's inquiry individually. Liao felt depressed since her best friend conceals everything. Tony accompanied Liao back home, the sight stroke a chord in her heart and Tony tried hard to comfort her, then they had sex. Liao was pregnant, it shocked Billie, whereas Tony felt difficult to choose. Finally both Liao and Billie left Tony and the three noticed the one they love the most is-themselves.

programme.title: The Heroic Trio / 東方三俠
programme.desc: The evil minions of an ancient eunuch are stealing baby boys from their hospital cribs. The only hope to save the city is in the hands of The Heroic Trio.

programme.title: Executioners / 現代豪俠傳
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a nuclear war, the city has become a living hell. An evil genius named Mr. Kim controls the only supply and takes over the city...

programme.title: Superstars Comedy: Mr. Vampire / 星影週末笑聲匯: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims...

programme.title: Black Mask / 黑俠
programme.desc: Li was part of “Squad 701”, a team of professional killers known as Black Mask, who do not feel pain or emotions. When the team was “exterminated” by the government after they discovered that some squad members are still capable of feelings, Li goes into hiding as a librarian. However, when another member of the Squad begins killing every major drug market, Li has to don the identity of Black Mask once again...

programme.title: Black Mask II / 黑俠II

However, he finds trouble with a demented scientist, Moloch, who uses a group of pro wrestlers in his experiment to combine animal DNA with human DNA. Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants...

programme.title: Midnight Fly / 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband...

programme.title: Point Of No Return / 一觸即發
programme.desc: After police detective Lau is ambushed and killed, his best friend Pitt vows to get the killer. A series of investigation follows. Pitt finally finds an eyewitness to the killing - Fat Goose who is persuaded to testify against the killer Lam Man Fu. Lam Man Fu chases and attacks Pitt and Fat Goose. Finally, Pitt arrests him but Superintendent Keung frees Lam Man Fu and removes Pitt from the case. Then Lam Man Fu firebombs Fat Goose's residence. Fat Goose moves into Pitt's home and strikes a fast friendship with Angel, Pitt's reporter sister...

programme.title: He Lives By Night / 夜驚魂
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target...

programme.title: Police Story 3 Super Cop / 警察故事III
programme.desc: Detective Chan is recruited by Interpol to infiltrate the operations of a drug lord. He is forced to survive with his wits and courage during the most dangerous mission.

programme.title: Hero Beyond The Boundary Of Time / 正牌韋小寶之奉旨溝女
programme.desc: Imperial Court member Wai Siu-Bo is sent forward in time to present-day Hong Kong, to find a woman who can cure the Emperor of his illness. Can Siu-Bo accomplish his mission?

programme.title: The Dead And The Deadly / 人嚇人
programme.desc: Fatboy is a helper to Grand Uncle who is the town's high priest. They are now found in the ancestral shrine of the Mas working wonders. Fatboy is also being reprimanded by Grand Uncle for being rude to his fiancee, Yuen. The last of the Mas, the rich family in town, is back but Ma Lucho is coming home dead. Accompanying the body is a woman who claims to be Ma's wife and very much pregnant. But Fatboy knows his boyhood friend Ma couldn't be a husband because he was impotent...

programme.title: It's A Mad Mad Mad World III / 富貴再三逼人
programme.desc: In the third installment of this comedy hit, Bill and his wife have become snobbish after they won the lottery in Canada. When they showed off their money at the bank to their friends, they lost it all during a bank robbery and had to move back to their small flat in the public housing estate. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Later, Bill was notified by the bank that they will be reimbursed for the money they lost in the robbery due to a security breach of the bank...

programme.desc: The citizens of a small town suffer from failed crops and corrupt officials. Their salvation comes in the form of a Robin Hood figure, the Iron Monkey, who steals from the rich to give to poor. When martial arts master Wong Kay-ying arrives, his martial arts skills lead local lawmen to suspect that he may be the masked outlaw. Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.

programme.title: Dreams Of Glory, A Boxer's Story. / 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon...

programme.title: Double Tap / 鎗王
programme.desc: The key witness of a famous trial and 6 cops are assassinated. Miu knows Rick is back. Years ago in a shooting contest, Rick and Miu knew they were borne to be the sworn enemies.

programme.desc: Big Nose Pao, a faithful and honest constable, was ordered to arrest a Pickpocket. However, each time he was caught, he was released by lack of evidence. Although the Pickpocket was tricky man, the money he stole from those dirty rich people was spent on the seven poor orphans he lived with. The Pickpocket intended to buy a house where he could keep more orphans. Under pressure from his officer, Big Nose Pao had to follow the pickpocket everywhere he went in order to stop him from committing his crimes. The Pickpocket learned that Gold Teeth had robbed many jewels and he therefore planned to steal from him...

Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. programme.title: The Conman / 賭俠1999
programme.desc: King, the Con Man, is regarded as the successor of God of Gamblers. Dragon opts for gambling and approaches King, hoping to learn gambling tricks from him...
