Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?.

programme.title: Rich & Famous / 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued...

Although Fong knows his Master wants to capture these evil spirits, he finds himself attracted to the Ghost and allows them to go free. The monks' stay at the Temple is prolonged due to Fong carelessly misplacing their valuable Taolisman, the Gold Suddna. During a trip to the corrupt local town, the High Priest meets Yin by chance and a series of misunderstandings evolve...

Later, Jeanne's aunt from the States came to Hong Kong with a professor and tried to match him up with Jeanne. Abel and Jeanne turned from enemies to friends...

programme.title: Magic Cop / 驅魔警察
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling...

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Dragons Forever / 「武」績「彪」炳: 飛龍猛將
programme.desc: Hotshot lawyer is hired by a mysterious chemistry factory to dig up dirt on an inconvenient fishery seeking damaging court action. Sidekick Hung and professional crook Yuen swiftly sprint to Chan's aid. Ironically the gang finds their toughness softening in the face of two gorgeous ladies at the fishery. They inadvertently hit a center nerve of the chemical factory when they unmask the hideous facade of a narcotic syndicate.

Though initially refusing, he only agrees so he can keep a close eye on his cop brother Kit, who is working undercover to infiltrate Lung's organization. After Lung is framed for the murder of a rival gang leader, he turns to Tse-Ho, who helps him escape to New York where he is joined by Ken, the equally deadly twin brother of the deceased Mark. Returning to Hong Kong to rejoin Tse-Ho and Kit, they soon discover the true mastermind behind the entire operation, and in true John Woo fashion, set out to take him down.

After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. But a misconception broke out which overshadowed the relationship amongst the three of them. It led Chai and Yung to divergence and the fight of Kok to Malacca...

Crow escapes back to Taipei, only to find his girlfriend has committed suicide after Kui's gang has raped her. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta...

programme.title: Spooky Encounters / 鬼打鬼
programme.desc: Courageous Cheung (Sammo Hung) has the reputation of being the bravest man around. Carrying such a reputation often leads him to accept various challenges to test his courage. His wife's secret lover is a wealthy and powerful man who wishes Cheung out of his way before he discovers his wife's infidelity. Hiring a taoist priest to get rid of him, Cheung is challenged to spend the night in an old abandoned temple were the priest will use his dark magic to attempt to bring an end to Cheung's life.

programme.title: Perfect Exchange / 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindles millions of dollars, but he is caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison...

programme.title: Easy Money / 通天大盜
programme.desc: An armored car of the Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club transporting several million dollars is robbed by professionals from different countries hired by Michelle. The police put Senior Inspector King to be in charge of the case and Lam, the representative from the insurance company also joins the investigation...

programme.title: Who Is The Craftiest / 奸人本色
programme.desc: Leung Piu a swindler, cheats Yue Nan out of his life savings. This leads to Yue Nan's death, leaving his daughter Winnie behind. The Kang family, long disgusted by Leung's treachery, vow to avenge Yue Nan. They decide to “fight deceit with deceit”, exploiting Leung's greed to lure him into a trap, but Leung outsmarts Kang family. As the conflict escalates, Leung continuously sows discord between Kang's brothers Mon and Chuen. When Leung believes he has triumphed by triggering infighting within Kang family...

programme.title: Finale In Blood / 大鬧廣昌隆
programme.desc: An unusual story about an unusual love. Fang Yin comes from countryside to take over and run her father's hotel. She finds herself unable to cope. In distress, she turns to the first man ever to enter her life. It's a big mistake. One night, radio announcer Cheng Ming-pao is saved from drowning by the umbrella. He and she meet and confide in each other. It's Fang Yin's turn to tell Cheng Ming-pao she must leave him and that her ex-lover must pay the debt in kind...

programme.title: And I Hate You So / 小親親
programme.desc: Zhang hosts a top radio program that offers advice regarding love affairs. He starts a love-war relationship with Wu, a columnist, when she hears him gossiping on her love life!

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Mr Vampire II / 「武」績「彪」炳: 殭屍家族
programme.desc: Antique dealer Kwok roams the countryside with his two assistants searching for rare objects. One day they fall into the cellar of a shrine. There they find three vampires, all rendered harmless by talismans. Kwok takes Sonny Vampire to town, but when the talisman is removed accidentally, the vampire escapes and is being hidden by 6-year-old Chia Chia then. Papa Vampire and Mama Vampire are awakened too when the talismans fall off. Dr. Lin and reporter Ha decide to help stop the vampires from killing people...

programme.title: Fist Of Fury / 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised...

programme.title: The Hand Of Death / 少林門
programme.desc: The Shaolin Temple is the cradle of anti-Manchu patriots in the 17th century. However, a Shaolin renegade Shih has defected to the Manchu and is leading a suppression of patriots trying to overthrow the Qing Dynasty. Tan Hsiung, a patriot, is arrested and killed by Shih. The Shaolin Abbot thus calls on his best student, Yun Fei to stop Shih from killing more people. Yun happens to find help from another anti-Manchu patriot, Tan, who is actually Tan Hsiung's younger brother. Along with help of Zorro, a master swordsman...

programme.title: Return To A Better Tomorrow / 新英雄本色
programme.desc: Cool and brave, Tong is the most famous big brother. Ha, a loyal follower of Tong, is charged murdering his unfaithful wife's lover. Fortunately, he is saved by Tong's lawyer...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles / 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

programme.title: The Last Blood / 驚天十二小時
programme.desc: Tarka Lama, a famous leader of religion in Asia, visits Singapore with his disciple/escort for a special mission. No sooner have they arrived the airport, Lama is assassinated in the welcoming ceremony...

programme.title: Gorgeous / 玻璃樽
programme.desc: C.N. faces his greatest challenge when he meets young country girl Bu and falls in love! But when Howie sets a trap for him, C.N. must prepare to fight for his lady and his life!

programme.title: The Intellectual Trio / 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Interpol Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger...

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return / 賭神 2
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the events of the first God of Gamblers film. Ko Chun is now living a peaceful retirement on his French estate with his pregnant wife Wan Yau, while his disciples Knife and Sing have become world-renowned in their own right. Chun declines repeated challenges from other top-ranked gamblers, having given up gambling in favor of the quiet life. Chun's friend and former bodyguard, Lung Wu, the 'God Of Guns', comes to pay him a visit. While the two are away from the house for a friendly shooting competition, Chau Siu-Chee, a gambler and the world's number one contender to Ko Chun's title, arrives and murders his wife and unborn son in order to goad Chun into a gambling match. After a shootout with Chau Siu-Chee's henchmen, Ko Chun arrives to discover his wife dying. With her last breath, she asks Chun to promise that he will not gamble or admit his real identity for one year, in the hopes that he will not lose his life in an impulsive act of revenge. C

programme.title: The Dragon Chronicles The Maidens of Heavenly Mountains / 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: The one who solves hermit Ding's chess game will become the grand master of martial arts. A shaolin young monk must solve the complex game to forestall great calamity...

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: Righting Wrongs / 「武」績「彪」炳: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own!

programme.title: The Way Of The Dragon / 猛龍過江
programme.desc: Chen's restaurant is being targeted by the local mafia. Tang fends off the gangsters and wins her admiration. The mafia boss sends a gunman to kill Tang, but Tang defeats him...

programme.title: Beast Cops / 野獸刑警
programme.desc: Mike is an expatriate inspector and is put in charge of an anti-Triad unit. The group includes Chao, a bad-tempered, undisciplined policeman who causes him so much trouble. And now they are facing a big problem, the reigning king of the streets, Wah, a crimeload on the rise...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Michael Wong / 影人映語 -型「德」起！ - 王敏德
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor?

programme.title: Iron Sister / 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion in the 1930's. A traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.title: Story Of Ricky / 力王
programme.desc: Ricky is sent to prison. In the jail, he sees the prisoners being exploited and tortured by chief warden Cobra. Ricky decides to stand up against them. After many setbacks, Ricky gets the support of the other prisoners...

programme.title: Righting Wrongs / 執法先鋒
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own!

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Lee Lai Chun / 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like?

programme.title: The Intellectual Trio / 龍鳳智多星
programme.desc: Interpol Simon visits Hong Kong and is served by Wing, the young and witty cop. Their adventures begin when they encounter two pretty girls, Pretty eyes and Slant eyes. These two girls are pickpockets and have stolen a jade from the professional killer. The killer is desperate to get back his treasure, that even though the detectives try to protect the sisters, the four are in great danger...

programme.title: Bullets of Love / 不死情謎
programme.desc: Sam and his team are members of a Serious Crime Unit in the District Crime Squad, conducting a crackdown on an international crime organization trafficking in the human cargo of illegal immigrants. The team successfully dissolves the group and destroys its power in Southeast Asia. They arrest one of the group's leaders, Night. At the court, Night is charged with several offences and is being prosecuted by Sam's fiancee, Ann. Ann tries her best to convict Night for all the crimes he committed. However, the defense lawyer is tough and manipulative and finally, Night is convicted on only one of the charges in human smuggling and sentenced to three years imprisonment. Night is unrepentant and vows to take his revenge and destroy the couple one day. During the lawyer's visit, Night relays this message to his brother, Day, and asks Day to carry out the revenge for him...

programme.title: Naughty Boys / 扭計雜牌軍
programme.desc: Four sworn brothers failed heist and get into jail for years. Sheng is set free. The three ask Sheng to get the hidden loot and wait for their eventual reunion. Sheng discovers the loot has disappeared but the other three are convinced Sheng has stolen it. Sheng has to escape. His childhood lover Chuan tries to help him to go overseas but is hurt when Sheng falls for insurance detective Bonnie. Sheng and Bonnie buy tickets from Liang who is left holding the bag when his boss absconds with the money...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Peter Lai / 影人映語 -詞「得」達意 - 黎彼得
programme.desc: Although a lot of people recognize Peter Lai mostly from his TV drama's performance, he is arguably one of the veteran lyricists in Hong Kong music industry. Looking back from ‘Choi San Dou' to ‘Monica', his lyrics have definitely contributed the success of numerous well-known immortals. Why would he become an actor while debuted as a lyricist? Worked with so many famous stars, what related interesting stories he is going to reveal to us?

programme.title: Duel To The Death / 生死決
programme.desc: The best swordsmen have made it a historical ritual to meet every 10 years for a showdown of fighting skills and powers. The leading fighter of the Japanese ninjas, Hashimoto, and the Shaolin chief Ching Wan have come to respect each other after they met, but tradition demands that they lock swords. Their honor is put to the test when rogue ninjas barge into the battlefield...

programme.title: Crazy Companies / 最佳損友
programme.desc: After the death of their father, Kwai was asked to take over half of his father's properties but Fu was not willing to share. Fu then sent three pals to ruin Kwai's reputation...

programme.title: Hocus Pocus / 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop / 大內密探零零發
programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. Fat smells the trouble and goes along secretly to protect the Emperor...

programme.title: To Catch A Thief / 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: An illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village try to ro

programme.title: Skillful fighter: Yuen Biao: A Man Called Hero / 「武」績「彪」炳: 中華英雄
programme.desc: Hero goes home with excited but he finds his parent was killed. Gian took a group of foreigners to Hero's parents and forced them to hand over the Red Sword, their family treasure...

programme.title: Game Of Death / 死亡遊戲
programme.desc: When Billy refuses to be intimidated by henchman Steiner, Dr. Land orders his assassination to serve as an example to others. Stick sneaks onto the set of Billy's new film....

programme.title: Family Dinner S3E5 -The Garner Family / 安德魯來晚餐 第5集 - 嘉納
programme.desc: The Garner sisters have always been close, but their bond became even tighter after the passing of their mother.

programme.title: Family Dinner S3E6 -The Kwon Family / 安德魯來晚餐 第6集 - 權
programme.desc: The Kwon family immigrated from Korea to North Carolina 40 years ago, bringing their traditional Korean recipes with them.

programme.title: Next Baking Master: Paris S1E2 -Sugar, Spice And Everything... / 烘焙大師在巴黎 第2集 - 糖與香草
programme.desc: Everything is sweeter in Paris as Stephanie Boswell and Ludo Lefebvre challenge the bakers to create iconic petit fours.

programme.title: Steal This House S1E5 -Easy Livin Up North / 低價醜屋變好宅 第5集 - 北方的悠閒生活
programme.desc: A woman wants to move closer to her family in beautiful Leland, Michigan, but skyrocketing vacation resort prices have put everything out of her budget.

programme.title: Love & Translation S1E13 -Ja Or Nein? / 愛情不必翻譯 第13集 - 是與否
programme.desc: It's time for the men to make their final decisions. One woman reveals a big secret.

programme.title: 90 Day: The Last Resort S3E13 -One Last Fantasy / 到美國結婚去:最後一搏 第13集 - 最後的美夢
programme.desc: Russ learns a secret from Pao's past, Thais steps into a dominant role with Patrick, and Kara and Guillermo get hot and heavy.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance Uk S4E10 -Its Almost Game Over Isnt It / 到英國結婚去 第10集 - 一切都完了
programme.desc: Andy prepares to marry Arrah, but it's mixed emotions without loved ones by his side. Marco belatedly asks Sarah's dad for her hand in marriage.

programme.title: Steal This House S1E5 -Easy Livin Up North / 低價醜屋變好宅 第5集 - 北方的悠閒生活
programme.desc: A woman wants to move closer to her family in beautiful Leland, Michigan, but skyrocketing vacation resort prices have put everything out of her budget.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E3 -Safari CSI / 尚比亞野生故事 第3集 - 草原狩獵鑑證科
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E3 -Villains / 奇異地球 第3集 - 反派角色
programme.desc: Meet nature’s most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad don’t get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white shark’s electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: Planet Weird S1E4 -Sidekicks / 奇異地球 第4集 - 配角英雄
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge S1E3 -So Long and Thanks for All the Fish / 飢餓遊戲：阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 第3集 - 再見了，也謝謝所有魚兒
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E3 -Rocco, Harold and Cindy / 動物知心友 第3集 - 羅科、哈羅德、辛蒂
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E4 -Milton, Cash and Bentley / 動物知心友 第4集 - 米爾頓、凱許、本特利
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkey’s birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution S1E5 -Social Animals / 進化的奧秘 第5集 - 社會性動物
programme.desc: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E3 -Rocco, Harold and Cindy / 動物知心友 第3集 - 羅科、哈羅德、辛蒂

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E2 -Surviving the Flood / 大貓小世界 第2集 - 洪水倖存記
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. programme.title: Mysteries of Evolution S1E6 -Ancient Lineages / 進化的奧秘 第6集 - 古老血統
programme.desc: Some call them “living fossils”, but that's just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals' early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

programme.title: Animals at Play S1E1 -The Power of Playtime / 動物玩學誌 第1集 - 玩鬧的重要
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa S2E1 -The Garden Route / 非洲園遊誌 第1集 - 花園大道
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa S2E2 -Kruger's Pafuri / 非洲園遊誌 第2集 - 克魯格的帕富里營地
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It’s a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa S2E3 -Augrabies Falls / 非洲園遊誌 第3集 - 奧赫拉比斯瀑布
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word “oukurubes” which means “place of thunder” in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa S2E4 -The Lower Zambezi / 非洲園遊誌 第4集 - 尚比西河下游
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa’s greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they’re to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa S2E5 -Hluhluwe-Imfolozi / 非洲園遊誌 第5集 - 赫盧赫盧韋-印姆弗魯茲公園
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park’s establishment gave rhinos a lifeline – breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Turtle Beach / 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: Locals call it the ‘arribada’, or ‘arrival’. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E3 -Realm of the Spectacled Bear / 拉丁美生态奥秘 第3集 - 眼鏡熊的國度
programme.desc: Get to know South America’s only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Shark Squad S1E1 -Island of the White Shark / 鯊魚小隊 第1集 - 白鯊島
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad S1E2 -Bimini Sharklab / 鯊魚小隊 第2集 - 比米尼鯊魚
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: Shark Squad S1E3 -Chasing Mako / 鯊魚小隊 第3集 - 追逐灰鯖鯊
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before it’s too late.

programme.title: Shark Squad S1E4 -How Smart Are Sharks? / 鯊魚小隊 第4集 - 鯊魚有多聰明？
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E3 -Praying for Rain / 逐雨之途 第3集 - 祈雨
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E2 -Tigers / 大貓九命 第2集 - 老虎
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E3 -Leopards / 大貓九命 第3集 - 豹子
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cat’s fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E1 -The Ghost of the Mountains / 雪豹獵奇 第1集 - 高山之靈
programme.desc: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill S1E2 -To Catch a Legend / 雪豹獵奇 第2集 - 追捕傳奇
programme.desc: Sniff around The Dude’s territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S1E1 -The Hungry Leopard / 非洲獵人 第1集 - 餓豹傳說
programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.desc: A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys S1E1 -Crossing the Danakil / 征戰火焰山 第1集 - 穿越達納基爾
programme.desc: The Danakil Depression in Ethiopia is not only one of the most inhospitable places on Earth, but is one of the most geologically active. Now, volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer is taking a group of adventure tourists to cross the Danakil to see the Erte Ale volcano.

programme.title: Animals at Play S1E2 -Rules of the Game / 動物玩學誌 第2集 - 遊戲規則
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists’ cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed—all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E1 -Dragon Mountain: Surviving the Summit / 極限非洲 第1集 - 龍山：登頂
programme.desc: South Africa's Drakensberg is one of the continent's most impressive landscapes. It is home to sharp climatic and ecological gradients as physical conditions change for both land-based creatures and the Raptors that swirl in the skies above.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E2 -Lake Manyara National Park / 極限非洲 第2集 - 曼雅拉湖國家公園
programme.desc: In north Tanzania, towering mountains line a dramatic valley. Enriched by ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for life to thrive and its great centerpiece holds water through even the driest of times.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E3 -The Simien Mountains / 極限非洲 第3集 - 塞米恩山脈
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E4 -The Southern Drylands / 極限非洲 第4集 - 南部旱地
programme.desc: The Southern Drylands is a journey into the most arid and extreme environments in the furthest reaches of southern Africa. We go to spectacular but treacherous places where almost no rain falls, to find incredibly resilient creatures and learn the secrets to their survival. From the largest mammals to the fastest insects and even a ghost-like fish found nowhere else in the world, the Southern Drylands contain some extraordinary inhabitants, all connected by the daily challenges of living in some of most inhospitable habitats in the world.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E5 -Etosha: The Great White Place / 極限非洲 第5集 - 埃托沙：大白之地
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa S1E6 -The Linear Oasis / 極限非洲 第6集 - 綠洲綿延
programme.desc: Follow the course of South Africa’s Orange river from its origins to where it spills out into the Atlantic Ocean. Along the way we encounter a diverse range of habitats and the creatures they support, from the dry lands of the Richtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies; this is the story of the Linear Oasis. We reveal how life is adapted to survive along its course and discover a rich world of plants and animals.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks S1E5 -Mexico's Artificial Reefs / 「礁」來船禍 第5集 - 墨西哥的人造礁
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexico’s Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E1 -The Woodland Troop / 尚比亞野生故事 第1集 - 林地部隊
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E2 -Better Together / 尚比亞野生故事 第2集 - 團結力量大
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E3 -Safari CSI / 尚比亞野生故事 第3集 - 草原狩獵鑑證科
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E4 -Africa's Edens / 尚比亞野生故事 第4集 - 非洲伊甸園
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E4 -Killer Packs / 野生動物明星 第4集 - 殺手一族
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E5 -Living Together / 野生動物明星 第5集 - 同居
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature’s great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2E6 -Crocs and Hippos of Ndumo / 野生動物明星 第6集 - 努毛的鱷魚與河馬
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa’s amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants / 巨象同盟：長牙兄弟情
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world’s largest land mammal.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale / 大象傳奇
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story / 啄木鳥：樹洞故事
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world’s 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature’s best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary / 祕「蜜」日記
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys S1E2 -The Child of Fire / 征戰火焰山 第2集 - 火之子
programme.desc: Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as “The Child of Fire,” this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern?

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E3 -Guided By the Moon / 月球野性面 第3集 - 月光指引
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West S1E1 -River of Life / 金伯利：澳洲的狂野西境 第1集 - 生命之河
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E2 -Tigers / 大貓九命 第2集 - 老虎
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E5 -Shark Dynasty / 超獸 第5集 - 鯊族王朝
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature’s most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E6 -Shark Supremacy / 超獸 第6集 - 鯊界稱霸
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Rooted S1E1 -Memoirs of Acacia / 紮根 第1集 - 相思回憶錄
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E5 -The Valley of the Birds / 尚比亞野生故事 第5集 - 鳥之谷
programme.desc: Zambia’s Luangwa Valley is home to Africa’s biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here; each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer.

programme.desc: Italy's Mount Etna is one of the best places for volcano watchers and volcanologist Tom Pfeffier is hoping to get lucky and see a paroxysmal eruption, a short and very intense eruption that produces spectacular lava fountains.

programme.title: Superbeast S1E5 -Shark Dynasty / 超獸 第5集 - 鯊族王朝

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E3 -Leopards / 大貓九命 第3集 - 豹子
programme.desc: Battle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cat’s fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder S1E3 -Choices / 寧格魯：澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 第3集 - 抉擇
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloo’s conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon S1E1 -Jungle Killers / 顛沛流離亞馬遜 第1集 - 叢林殺手
programme.desc: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

programme.title: Rooted S1E2 -Sweet Seduction / 紮根 第2集 - 甜蜜誘惑
programme.desc: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E6 -African Myths / 尚比亞野生故事 第6集 - 非洲神話
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E7 -Chilema and Her Brother / 尚比亞野生故事 第7集 - 智利獁和牠的兄弟

programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia S2E8 -Tree Tales / 尚比亞野生故事 第8集 - 樹木傳說
programme.desc: Trees are Africa’s oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths’ most precious ecosystems.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E1 -Highlight 1 / Trucking Hell 第1集 - Highlight 1
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E2 -Highlight 2 / Trucking Hell 第2集 - Highlight 2
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck!

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E3 -Snakes on a Boat / Billy Goes North 第3集 - Snakes on a Boat
programme.desc: Billy and his partner Derick remove a nest of snakes from a houseboat, then he responds to a storage facility where some deer-elk hybrids are threatening to injure clients.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E4 -Paranormal Extermination / Billy Goes North 第4集 - Paranormal Extermination
programme.desc: Billy responds to a construction site where a vicious varmint has the tradespeople running scared. Then Billy and Bea investigate a haunted house to find the source of some strange noises.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E9 -Horses & Dogs / Extreme Animal Transport 第9集 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E10 -Camels / Extreme Animal Transport 第10集 - Camels
programme.desc: John runs Red Sun Camels in Broome, a tourist town in the north of Western Australia where visitors can experience a sunset camel ride along the famous Cable Beach. As his business expands, he needs seven more camels to add to the group, to enable his other camels to rest. But camels don’t come ready to be ridden by humans. Without extensive training they can be very dangerous, and the risk of them kicking a tourist could mean serious injury or even death. On the other side of Australia, 5000kms away, Peter has been commissioned by John to train and deliver seven wild camels. Known throughout Australia as the camel whisperer, Peter’s love of the animal is evident. Each of his seven beloved camels has a unique personality. It's a four-day transport. Due to Australia’s strict biosecurity laws, the camels have to pass a quarantine checkpoint at Kununurra, on the border of the Northern Territory and Western Australia. Clair is the government vet who will inspect each of the ani

programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. It’s a 50-hour non-stop drive from South Africa to Mozambique. The team must arrive at Zinave National Park before sunset on day 2 to safely offload the elephants. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E8 -Air Horse One / Extreme Animal Transport 第8集 - Air Horse One
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E1 -South Australia / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第1集 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E2 -Northern Territory / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第2集 - Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E13 -Dangerous Jobs (Snakes & Caimans) / Brave Wilderness 第13集 - Dangerous Jobs (Snakes & Caimans)
programme.desc: Coyote experiences the world's deadliest job with Australian snakes and catches a caiman.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E14 -Milking the Deadly Black Mamba & Green Mamba! / Brave Wilderness 第14集 - Milking the Deadly Black Mamba & Green Mamba!
programme.desc: Coyote Peterson milks the deadly green and black mambas for life-saving research!

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 S1E1 -The Force of Nature / The Force of Nature 2022 第1集 - The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E3 -Highlight 3 / Trucking Hell 第3集 - Highlight 3
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E4 -Highlight 4 / Trucking Hell 第4集 - Highlight 4
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E3 -Highlight 3 / Trucking Hell 第3集 - Highlight 3
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E4 -Highlight 4 / Trucking Hell 第4集 - Highlight 4
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. programme.title: Search4Hurt S4E5 -Hybrid Games / Search4Hurt 第5集 - Hybrid Games
programme.desc: Adam has an idea for a new event for hybrid athletes called Hybrid Games, so the team travels to W.A to be guinea pigs with powerlifting, Xterra and a beach OCR.

programme.title: Search4Hurt S4E6 -Turf Games / Search4Hurt 第6集 - Turf Games
programme.desc: As the team completes the three brutal events scheduled in 48 hours, Adam plans a surprise return to the East Coast with a Turf Games event in Sydney.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S1E3 -Zac Efron / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第3集 - Zac Efron
programme.desc: World-renowned survivalist Bear Grylls leads Zac Efron (Neighbors (2014)) on a non-stop extreme survival journey into the Northeast Appalachian mountain range wilderness. With Bear's help, Zac challenges himself physically, as well as mentally, on an awe-inspiring journey he could never have imagined.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E15 -Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy! / Brave Wilderness 第15集 - Giant Jungle Frog, Cheetah Encounter & Alligator Feeding Frenzy!
programme.desc: Coyote catches a giant frog, meets a cheetah, wrangles turtles, and feeds hungry alligators!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E1 -The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry / Hollywood Weapons 第1集 - The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry
programme.desc: Terry channels his inner Dr. Jones and tests 1 scene from Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade containing 3 different tests, two of which require a tank! The duo will travel down to Uvalde, TX to visit Drivetanks.com to see if a tank round will topple over a car, and if a 9mm round can travel through three Germans.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E2 -Equalizing Terry / Hollywood Weapons 第2集 - Equalizing Terry
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will test 3 scenes from Denzel Washington’s Equalizer films. Can Terry be as cool as Denzel and use propane tanks and a microwave to create an explosion, use a nail gun to take out the bad guy, or get a flash bang to ignite a room full of baking products?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E3 -Silencing Terry / Hollywood Weapons 第3集 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, so he and Larry take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a “silencer.” Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa himself from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons S4E4 -Meet The Smiths / Hollywood Weapons 第4集 - Meet The Smiths
programme.desc: Terry finally gets to compare himself to Brad Pitt!! Terry and Larry test 3 scenes from the action film Mr. and Mrs. Smith. Can a refrigerator or elevator door protect our heroes? Also, can you ignite a gas line with just a bullet? Larry may not look as stunning as Angelina Jolie, but he will help Terry find out the answers.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild S1E1 -Mom Gone Wild / Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第1集 - Mom Gone Wild
programme.desc: Survival expert Bear Grylls takes real people who inspire him into the wild. On the series premiere, Jennifer, a glamper mom of four - two of which have down syndrome - learns camping skills to impress her outdoor-loving family while Bear learns about her international quest that helped save lives.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Face the Wild S1E2 -Mission Possible / Bear Grylls: Face the Wild 第2集 - Mission Possible
programme.desc: Who says you can't do adventure without legs? Former recon marine and war hero Jonathon lost both of his legs in Afghanistan, but his wild spirit lifts him to new heights. programme.title: River Hunters S1E1 -Stirling - First War of Scottish Independence / River Hunters 第1集 - Stirling - First War of Scottish Independence
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, in the shadow of Stirling Castle, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, tackle the mighty river Forth. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be hunting for relics of Scotland’s greatest medieval warriors William Wallace and Robert The Bruce. And revealing secrets from the battle sites of their most famous victories against their hated English overlords.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E5 -Wild Wedding Party / Billy Goes North 第5集 - Wild Wedding Party
programme.desc: Billy and Terry make an urgent call to a wedding venue where wild turkeys are threatening to ruin the big day. Then Billy responds to an apartment where poisonous exotic pets are threatening the homeowner.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E6 -Sting Operation / Billy Goes North 第6集 - Sting Operation
programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E16 -Ancient Horseshoe Crab, Swimming with Alligators & Tokay Gecko Bite! / Brave Wilderness 第16集 - Ancient Horseshoe Crab, Swimming with Alligators & Tokay Gecko Bite!
programme.desc: Coyote finds a horseshoe crab, swims with alligators, and gets bitten by an invasive gecko!

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E1 -South Australia / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第1集 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. programme.title: Making Pandas S1E1 / Making Pandas 第1集
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Copi / Feral 第1集 - Copi
programme.desc: Considered a nuisance and trash fish, the Asian carp has overtaken the Illinois River's biomass and now outcompetes native species. Lucky for Yia, fishermen Clint Carter and Dave Buchanan have devised an ingenious way to rebrand this delicious fish by calling it Copy. Copy is now finding its way into restaurants across the country and Yia gets treated to a shore lunch after his day on the water.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Squirrels / Feral 第2集 - Squirrels
programme.desc: When Yia receives an offer to join Ryan 'Backwoods'' Dodd and his mentor, Barry Carter, on a squirrel hunt, he can't resist. Squirrel is hugely popular in the Hmong community and was a family favorite in the Vang household when Yia was growing up. As squirrel hunting has fallen out of favor with the hunting community, Backwoods, Barry, and Yia are excited to highlight this once-fashionable protein--even if it means they have to share.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S2E3 -Kate Hudson / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第3集 - Kate Hudson
programme.desc: Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson goes on a journey with Bear that involves a treacherous mountain range in Italy; Kate shares details of her unique upbringing.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E1 -Stirling - First War of Scottish Independence / River Hunters 第1集 - Stirling - First War of Scottish Independence
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, in the shadow of Stirling Castle, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, tackle the mighty river Forth. In the first archaeological river search of this spot ever, they’ll be hunting for relics of Scotland’s greatest medieval warriors William Wallace and Robert The Bruce. And revealing secrets from the battle sites of their most famous victories against their hated English overlords.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E5 -Wild Wedding Party / Billy Goes North 第5集 - Wild Wedding Party
programme.desc: Billy and Terry make an urgent call to a wedding venue where wild turkeys are threatening to ruin the big day. Then Billy responds to an apartment where poisonous exotic pets are threatening the homeowner.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E6 -Sting Operation / Billy Goes North 第6集 - Sting Operation
programme.desc: Billy and Beekeeper Ian extract a bee colony from a family home, then Billy has to dodge talons and beak to remove a Great Horned Owl from a house.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E16 -Ancient Horseshoe Crab, Swimming with Alligators & Tokay Gecko Bite! / Brave Wilderness 第16集 - Ancient Horseshoe Crab, Swimming with Alligators & Tokay Gecko Bite!
programme.desc: Coyote finds a horseshoe crab, swims with alligators, and gets bitten by an invasive gecko!

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia S3E1 -South Australia / Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第1集 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Making Pandas S1E1 / Making Pandas 第1集
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Copi / Feral 第1集 - Copi
programme.desc: Considered a nuisance and trash fish, the Asian carp has overtaken the Illinois River's biomass and now outcompetes native species. Lucky for Yia, fishermen Clint Carter and Dave Buchanan have devised an ingenious way to rebrand this delicious fish by calling it Copy. Copy is now finding its way into restaurants across the country and Yia gets treated to a shore lunch after his day on the water.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Squirrels / Feral 第2集 - Squirrels
programme.desc: When Yia receives an offer to join Ryan 'Backwoods'' Dodd and his mentor, Barry Carter, on a squirrel hunt, he can't resist. Squirrel is hugely popular in the Hmong community and was a family favorite in the Vang household when Yia was growing up. As squirrel hunting has fallen out of favor with the hunting community, Backwoods, Barry, and Yia are excited to highlight this once-fashionable protein--even if it means they have to share.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S2E3 -Kate Hudson / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第3集 - Kate Hudson
programme.desc: Oscar-nominated actress Kate Hudson goes on a journey with Bear that involves a treacherous mountain range in Italy; Kate shares details of her unique upbringing.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E3 -Highlight 3 / Trucking Hell 第3集 - Highlight 3
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell S2E4 -Highlight 4 / Trucking Hell 第4集 - Highlight 4
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

programme.title: ABC Late News:2026 E237 / ABC Late News 第237集
programme.desc: End your day with the latest on the day's top stories. ABC News has reporters across Australia and around the globe to uncover what's happening and why it matters. Presented by Craig Smart in Perth.

programme.title: Asia News Week:2026 E45 / Asia News Week 第45集
programme.desc: Yvonne Yong brings you a weekly roundup of the stories making news across the Asia region, plus what's trending on social media and making an impact on the culture and the way people live.

programme.title: The World:2026 E47 / The World 第47集
programme.desc: There's never been a more important time to stay in touch with what's happening in our world. Manny Tsigas presents the latest international news from ABC News correspondents as well as interviews with experts and guests.

programme.title: Gardening Australia:2026 E15 -People And Plants Growing Together / Gardening Australia 第15集 - People And Plants Growing Together
programme.desc: Costa and Hannah visit an eco-village to see how people and plants are growing together. Hannah plants five set-and-forget vegies, Costa goes foraging and visits a garden benefiting refugees, and we meet ecologist John Seed.

programme.title: Alone Australia S3E8 / Alone Australia 第8集
programme.desc: The remaining survivalists come face to face with their physical limitations. Can innovation save the day, or will a routine med check bring one survivalist to the end of the journey?

Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: Terre Nourriciere S2E4 -Acadian Land / Terre Nourriciere 第4集 - Acadian Land
programme.desc: In the New Acadia region, Melanie meets the historian Sylvain Gaudet. He talks to her about the Great Upheaval of 1755 and how the deportation of Acadians to English colonies marked Canadian history.

programme.title: Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature:2021-2022 E11 -Mercantour / Chroniques Mediterraneennes Nature 第11集 - Mercantour
programme.desc: The Mercantour National Park stretches across two French departments, Alpes-Maritimes and Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. Located in the high mountains, it is nevertheless very close to the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Meteo A La Carte:2025-2026 E241 / Meteo A La Carte 第241集
programme.desc: An interactive programme that's as fun as it is informative and reactive to the meteorological events of the moment. programme.title: L'art ET La Matiere S9E23 -100 Years Of The Prunier Restaurant / L'art ET La Matiere 第23集 - 100 Years Of The Prunier Restaurant
programme.desc: The 100th anniversary of a legendary restaurant: Prunier. And the fascinating history of blue, from Antiquity to its contemporary use.

programme.title: Tendance XXI Express S10E31 / Tendance XXI Express 第31集
programme.desc: Fashion, craftwork, design, beauty, cuisine, lifestyle... a round-up of the best moments from 'Tendance XXI'!

programme.title: Silence, CA Pousse !:2025-2026 E8 -The Landscapes Of The Loire Estuary / Silence, CA Pousse ! 第8集 - The Landscapes Of The Loire Estuary
programme.desc: In this issue: an interview with Jerome Desigaud, musician and luthier; Genoese pesto; the landscapes of the Loire Estuary; 'Don't panic': at Sophie's.

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs:2026 E6 -Watermael-Boitsfort / Les Ambassadeurs 第6集 - Watermael-Boitsfort
programme.desc: The most wooded municipality in Brussels, Watermael-Boitsfort also benefits from great architectural diversity. Focus on the CBR building, an example of functionalist and brutalist architecture. Then, a visit to the country's largest garden city and a meeting in the creative nest of comic book author Francois Deflandre.

programme.title: L'epicerie:2026 E10 -The New Price Accuracy Policy / L'epicerie 第10集 - The New Price Accuracy Policy
programme.desc: As grocery bills continue to soar, the new $15 price accuracy policy is a consumer right that can sometimes be difficult to claim.

programme.title: Passe-Moi Les Jumelles S13E5 -Nomadic Drawings / Passe-Moi Les Jumelles 第5集 - Nomadic Drawings
programme.desc: After cycling across several countries, Lucien Pilloud found his calling in Palermo, Sicily. Back in Switzerland, the young man decided to create and sell his illustrations as postcards sold on the street. It's an original approach that makes for some wonderful human encounters.

programme.title: Meteo A La Carte:2025-2026 E241 / Meteo A La Carte 第241集

programme.title: Passe-Moi Les Jumelles S12E11 -Bread: An Endless Cycle Of Skill And Passion / Passe-Moi Les Jumelles 第11集 - Bread: An Endless Cycle Of Skill And Passion
programme.desc: Natural slow-risen sourdough bread, its thick crust cracking with every bite. Rich in flavour, made with local flour, it keeps well and is filled with childhood memories. Bread made by two artisan bakers sharing a bakery in the heart of Geneva: Jerome Saugy and Sarah Bertin.

programme.title: Le Gout Des Rencontres Normandes:2025 E11 -Wellness Break In Remalard-En-Perche / Le Gout Des Rencontres Normandes 第11集 - Wellness Break In Remalard-En-Perche

programme.title: Echappees Belles S20E1 -Haute-Savoie, A Summer In The Aravis / Echappees Belles 第1集 - Haute-Savoie, A Summer In The Aravis

programme.title: Les Cueilleurs S1E6 -Seaweed / Les Cueilleurs 第6集 - Seaweed
programme.desc: Antoine Nicolas likes to refer to himself as a 'sea-bed farmer'. Even in midwinter he never hesitates to go diving, to gather some fifteen different species of seaweed. Brimming with iron, protein, minerals and vitamins, they are nutritionally rich and full of flavour.

programme.title: Cuisine Ouverte:2024-2025 E28 -In Isere With Alex Ramires / Cuisine Ouverte 第28集 - In Isere With Alex Ramires

programme.title: Tendance XXI S11E21 -Nona Source/Sweater/Verchant/Mini-Shorts / Tendance XXI 第21集 - Nona Source/Sweater/Verchant/Mini-Shorts
programme.desc: Nona Source is the place to be for beautiful fabrics, inspiring both the major luxury brands and the new generation of French designers. Find out all about the origins of the sweater. A land of memories and promises of contemporary refinement: welcome to the Domaine de Verchant! How to wear men's mini-shorts.

programme.title: Les Routes Du Gout S1E5 -Emma And Alfonso's Walk (1/2) / Les Routes Du Gout 第5集 - Emma And Alfonso's Walk (1/2)
programme.desc: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. programme.title: Mon Plus Beau Village S6E4 -Robin Soysa In Laneffe / Mon Plus Beau Village 第4集 - Robin Soysa In Laneffe
programme.desc: In the province of Namur, Robin Soysa stops in the village of Laneffe. There he meets Ivan, a perfumer who puts his talent at the service of visitors. After a sensory discovery trail, columnist Jessica Riga joins the duo for a deeply emotional sequence.
