programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep1
programme.desc: Nukumizu witnesses his classmate, Anna, get dumped, and gets to know the 'losing heroines', Lemon and Chika. Nukumizu's mysterious youth story revolving around these 'Makeines' begins!

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep2
programme.desc: Lemon invites Nukumizu to talk in the gym storage room, but they get locked inside. They get rescued as childhood friend Ayano visits Lemon. Then, they visit the Literature Club together...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep3
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari debate about tap water. The Literature Club goes on a training camp to produce a web novel as proof of their club activities. At night, a fireworks accident happens...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep4
programme.desc: Komari confesses to Tamaki. Tensions between Koto and Tamaki flare up as Koto leaves the site. Nukumizu escapes reality, but to no avail. Later, Nukumizu hears a rumor about him and Yanami.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep5
programme.desc: Yanami visits Nukumizu and Kaju overreacts. Yanami invites Nukumizu to a cafe and they spot Lemon and Ayano together. They follow the two, but are approached by Ayano's girlfriend, Chihaya.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep6
programme.desc: Ayano grills Nukumizu who was with Chihaya. He then misunderstands that Nukumizu likes Yanami. Including Lemon and Yanami, they hang out while Lemon tries to hook Ayano and Chihaya up, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep7
programme.desc: Lemon tells Nukumizu her feelings for Ayano and confronts Ayano and Chihaya. Nighttime at school, Lemon and Ayano share their feelings and reminisce about the past. Lemon then makes a move...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep7
programme.desc: Lemon tells Nukumizu her feelings for Ayano and confronts Ayano and Chihaya. Nighttime at school, Lemon and Ayano share their feelings and reminisce about the past. Lemon then makes a move...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep8
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari become vice president and president of the literature club. Yanami proposes an idea for their exhibition at the Tsuwabuki Festival. Things seem to be going well, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep9
programme.desc: While preparing for the festival, Nukumizu and Komari catch Tamaki and Koto on a date. Unable to interact with them like before, Komari decides to prepare the exihibit's manuscript alone.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep10
programme.desc: Preparation for the exhibition is complete and Komari returns. At the festival, Nukumizu and Komari tour around the campus. Later, Koto talks to Nukumizu while Komari is alone with Tamaki...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep11
programme.desc: Komari struggles to practice for the club presidents' meeting. Upon Yanami's suggestion, they head out but Nukumizu and Komari end up arguing. They remain at odds as the meeting day arrives.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep12
programme.desc: Yanami ropes the club members into her 'fake boyfriend project', leading to a mock date between her and Nukumizu. Ms. Konuki gifts some tickets to Non Hoi Park, which becomes the date venue.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep2
programme.desc: To track down the location of Magius base, Yachiyo hunts down Black Feathers. She encounters Kuroe and a small Kyubey. While chasing after Kuroe, Yachiyo bumps into Mifuyu Azusa.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep3
programme.desc: Yachiyo and Kuroe find Iroha within the 'Perennial Cherry Tree' rumor, where they are devoured by the Doppel of silence. They awaken in a 'dream world', where Yachiyo tries to wake Iroha up.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep9
programme.desc: The event with Galois turns out to be an act to test Sariphi's worthiness as queen. Sariphi gains the support of the ichthyosaureans, but Anubis refuses to accept it...

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep10
programme.desc: On the day before a holy fete where the current king stands before his people donning the first king's mantle, a divine night triggers and Leonhart remains in his human form the next day.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep3
programme.desc: Nene vows to get back at Arisu for seeing them undressed by catching him in an embarrassing situation. After school, they spot him entering a cafe, and they see him dressed as a waiter!?

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep4
programme.desc: Shinobu Uzuki is swamped with work as the school's sports festival approaches. The club members worry she might be pushing herself. Seeing this, Arisu takes her to a quiet spot...

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep6
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep7
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: NISEKOI: Ep3
programme.desc: With Christmas around the corner, Chitoge is terrified at the idea of introducing Raku to her mother as her boyfriend. Who is Chitoge's mom and what will become of their Christmas?

programme.title: NISEKOI: Ep4
programme.desc: Chitoge asks her mother, Hana, to spend Christmas Eve with her and is turned down. Raku is determined to resolve all misunderstandings between the two.

programme.title: NISEKOI: Ep5
programme.desc: Marika faces the prospect of having to retake her next exam. She asks Raku to look after her pet parrot for a day. Being an animal lover, he agrees. However, pet-sitting turns out to be a major ordeal.

programme.title: NISEKOI: Ep6
programme.desc: It's Valentine's Day. Although Raku has never received chocolates before, he can't help feeling hopeful. Meanwhile, Chitoge, Marika, and Kosaki have each crafted chocolates in their own way.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep14
programme.desc: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep15
programme.desc: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep16
programme.desc: With the Jaegerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep17
programme.desc: Marley launches a surprise attack on the Shiganshina District where it all began, and the Titans make their move. The Founding Titan and Armored Titan face off once more.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep11
programme.desc: Raphael tells Foll what he knows about her father, Orbas the Wise, and warns of an impending crisis. Chastille teams up with Zagan to defeat the Chimera, and receives a request from Raphael.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep12
programme.desc: Foll continues living with Zagan and Nephy while Raphael is hired as their butler. While shopping at town for a dinner party with Chastille, they find a broken gramophone at Manuela's shop.

programme.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke up Piloting the Strongest Starship! Ep7
programme.desc: Takahiro 'Hiro' is reborn into his favourite game, commanding the best starship. He journeys across space as a mercenary to fulfil his dream of buying an expensive house with a garden.

programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep6
programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep8
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Ep3
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Ep4

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Ep5

programme.title: Turtle Beach

programme.title: Wild Latin America Ep3
programme.desc: Get to know South America's only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern Peru.

programme.title: Shark Squad Ep1
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first.

programme.title: Shark Squad Ep2

programme.title: Shark Squad Ep3

programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought.

programme.title: Someone Like Me / 像我這樣的愛情
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire / 驅魔龍族馬小玲
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Trouble Girl / 小曉
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor / 紅毯先生
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmer’s role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: Cold War 2 / 寒戰2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau’s wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles / 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Burning Stars / 孤星計劃
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Just 1 Day / 給我一天
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say “yes”?

programme.title: Love After Love / 第一爐香
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Chang’s first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunt’s puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: Caught in Time / 除暴
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name / 醬園弄·懸案
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone’s fate.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen / 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. programme.title: The Goldfinger / 金手指
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong’s biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Smashing Frank / 搗破法蘭克
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit / 浴火之路
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: The Monkey King 2 / 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience / 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Customs Frontline / 海關戰線
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Look Up / 一樣的天空
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong’s Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Fengmen Village Horror / 封門村驚魂
programme.desc: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

programme.title: Give Me Five / 哥，你好
programme.desc: Xiao Wu lives an idle life with his father, who is struggling with Alzheimer’s disease with only fragmented memories of his wife. To help recover his father’s memories, Xiao Wu is transported back in time, where he accidentally alters his parents’ past. He must now reunite the pair, or risk never being born.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer / 消失的兇手
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: Scare Out / 驚蟄無聲
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence unit's urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan / 前任4: 英年早婚
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: The Goldfinger / 金手指
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong’s biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Smashing Frank / 搗破法蘭克

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit / 浴火之路

programme.title: Killing Angels / 魅影狂花
programme.desc: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

programme.title: Laoshan Taoist / 嶗山道士
programme.desc: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the master's teachings of "Think No Evil". As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

programme.title: Beauty of Tang Men / 唐門：美人江湖
programme.desc: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yan's name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Ghost Sniper / 幽靈狙擊手
programme.desc: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

programme.title: Water Monster / 水怪2黑木林
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brother's murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

programme.title: Shu Jian En Chou Lu / 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the society's members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fu's treasure. Meanwhile, Yu's real identity also surfaces.

programme.title: Crazy Old Father / 瘋狂老爹
programme.desc: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

programme.title: Hunting No Man's Land / 獵殺無人區
programme.desc: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Legend of Detective Dee / 狄仁傑之運河驚龍
programme.desc: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

programme.title: White Haired Witch / 白髮魔女外傳
programme.desc: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

programme.title: Forensic Medicine Song Ci / 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
programme.desc: Tasked with absolving Wu's wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

programme.title: Monster Hunt in Kaifeng / 伏妖開封府之禦貓展昭
programme.desc: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

programme.title: Wild Ghost / 山鬼
programme.desc: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

programme.title: The Legend of Kunlun / 發丘天官：崑崙墟
programme.desc: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with "One Hundred Gods". Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

programme.title: Vanquishing the Demons / 少林降魔
programme.desc: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

programme.title: Mad Spider Sea / 怒海狂蛛
programme.desc: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrade's death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

programme.title: Killing Angels / 魅影狂花
programme.desc: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

programme.title: Laoshan Taoist / 嶗山道士
programme.desc: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the master's teachings of "Think No Evil". As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

programme.title: Beauty of Tang Men / 唐門：美人江湖
programme.desc: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yan's name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Ghost Sniper / 幽靈狙擊手
programme.desc: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

programme.title: Water Monster / 水怪2黑木林
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brother's murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

programme.title: Shu Jian En Chou Lu / 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the society's members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fu's treasure. Meanwhile, Yu's real identity also surfaces.

programme.title: Crazy Old Father / 瘋狂老爹
programme.desc: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

programme.title: Hunting No Man's Land / 獵殺無人區
programme.desc: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Water Monster / 水怪2黑木林
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brother's murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

programme.title: Shu Jian En Chou Lu / 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the society's members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fu's treasure. Meanwhile, Yu's real identity also surfaces.

programme.title: Crazy Old Father / 瘋狂老爹
programme.desc: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

programme.title: Hunting No Man's Land / 獵殺無人區
programme.desc: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Legend of Detective Dee / 狄仁傑之運河驚龍
programme.desc: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

programme.title: White Haired Witch / 白髮魔女外傳
programme.desc: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

programme.title: Forensic Medicine Song Ci / 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
programme.desc: Tasked with absolving Wu's wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

programme.title: Monster Hunt in Kaifeng / 伏妖開封府之禦貓展昭
programme.desc: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

programme.title: Wild Ghost / 山鬼
programme.desc: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

programme.title: The Legend of Kunlun / 發丘天官：崑崙墟
programme.desc: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with "One Hundred Gods". Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

programme.title: Vanquishing the Demons / 少林降魔
programme.desc: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

programme.title: Mad Spider Sea / 怒海狂蛛
programme.desc: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrade's death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

programme.title: Killing Angels / 魅影狂花
programme.desc: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

programme.title: Laoshan Taoist / 嶗山道士
programme.desc: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the master's teachings of "Think No Evil". As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

programme.title: Beauty of Tang Men / 唐門：美人江湖
programme.desc: Within the Tang Sect lies a treasure that will unveil names of future villains, who the Sect will kill before they can commit their evil acts. When Sect leader Yan's name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: A Good Deal
programme.desc: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no one's plan will survive.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
programme.desc: After a hybrid monster slaughters her family, Gabriella becomes a Blood Hunter bent on revenge. Caught in an explosion, she is wounded and rescued by hunters Max and Kali, then joins their group. When they learn hybrid demons are planning an attack, the hunters strike first, raiding their lair to prevent disaster, only to fall into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Web of Death / 五毒天羅
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix / 鳳還巢
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket / 奇門怪招爛頭蟀
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife / 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights / 文素臣
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army’s help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins / 阿牛發達記
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman / 儒俠
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond / 鑽石艷盜
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus’ Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century / 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies…

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall / 王昭君
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun’s warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears / 英雄無淚
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment / 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun’s warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears / 英雄無淚
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment / 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web / 盤絲洞
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother’s Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing / 茅山殭屍拳
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Glass House
programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.
