programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: In the last battle of Yi Sun-Sin in 1598, he fought against the Japanese army and intertwined with the Ming dynasty, bringing the 7-year Japanese invasions of Korea to an end...

programme.title: The Pirates
programme.desc: Before the founding of the Joseon Dynasty, envoys from China lose the Royal Seal to a whale. A group of bandits attempt to retrieve it for a large reward and run into a group of pirates.

programme.title: The Ultimate Duo
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.title: The Terror, Live
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.title: Fist & Furious
programme.desc: A former detective grants permission to a freelance video journalist to cover his revenge journey on a mob boss whom previously killed his partner during an investigation.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Assassin Sook-hee is recruited as a sleeper agent with the promise of freedom after ten years of service. But after secrets from her past destroy her normal life, she decides to take revenge.

programme.title: Second Sister
programme.desc: So-eun, grieving her sister’s suicide after sexual harassment and cyberbullying, teams up with a private investigator Jun-gyeong to uncover the dark truth behind the malicious rumors.

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises swiftly to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90's Korea.

programme.title: Boy In The Pool
programme.desc: Seok-young bumps into Woo-ju and they get closer after Woo-ju saves her from drowning. They lost touch after Woo-ju moves to Seoul to be a swimmer. Will they be able to meet again?

programme.title: Because I Love You
programme.desc: After an accident, a talented songwriter transforms into a messenger of love by connecting people who having trouble finding love and expressing their feelings.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Seung-min, a former rock singer scarred by a humiliating past, reunites with his first love Bo-na. As romance sparks again, hidden secrets and old wounds threaten their second chance.

programme.title: Exhuma
programme.desc: Exhuma follows two shamans, a feng shui expert and an undertaker as they seek to help a Korean-American family tormented by an ancestral curse.

programme.title: Dragon Inn Part 1: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn is a Chinese restaurant that also serves as a safe house for a revenge team. A murder case arises, and the victim turns out to be a close friend of one of the members...

programme.title: Sori: Voice From The Heart
programme.desc: A father searching for his missing daughter finds a satellite that remembers sounds from across the world. Using his daughter's voice as a beacon, the satellite helps him track her down.

programme.title: The Ghost Game
programme.desc: 6 students head to a underground reservoir and perform a necromancy ritual but nothing seems to happen. Terror unfolds when the ritual becomes a deadly curse and threatens their lives...

programme.title: Mr. Zoo: The Missing Vip
programme.desc: After discovering he can suddenly talk to animals, an intelligence agent partners with a canine pal to handle a case that has gone sideways.

programme.title: The Snitch
programme.desc: Kang-soo was falsely accused and imprisoned. A prosecutor offered him a deal to be a snitch in exchange for a reduced sentence and Kang-soo starts to shake up the drug investigation...

programme.title: The King's Warden
programme.desc: In 1455, a village chief, who seeks prosperity for himself and the people, volunteers Cheongnyeongpo as a place of exile, only to receive a young, dethroned king sent into banishment.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon And The Lost Talisman
programme.desc: Dr. Cheon is a fake exorcist who cannot see or hear any ghosts. One day, a woman comes to Dr. Cheon, asking him to save her possessed younger sister...

programme.title: Room No. 7
programme.desc: Doo-Sik tries to evade bankruptcy by selling his DVD screening business, but a crisis arises as he discovers a corpse and a stash of drugs that belongs to his employee in screening room number seven.

programme.title: Cart
programme.desc: As a social critique, ‘Cart’ tells a story of the employees of a retail supermarket band together when the contract workers are summarily laid off.

programme.title: The Attorney
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment
programme.desc: Ma Seok-Do investigates a drug-trafficking app, uncovers a link to an illegal organization. As Baek Chang-Gi terrorizes the gambling market, an alliance is formed to stop the threat.

programme.title: One Win
programme.desc: Woo-jin is the newly appointed manager of a girls' volleyball team which is going to disband. The new owner sold all ace players for money and asked the team to win at least once.

programme.title: Forbidden Dream
programme.desc: Two Korean inventors develop a 20-year relationship while advancing the field of astronomy.

programme.title: Heo's Diner Ep9
programme.desc: Based on a web novel of the same name, a man from Joseon dynasty accidentally travels 400 years into the future and opens a restaurant unintentionally in modern Seoul.

programme.title: Heo's Diner Finale

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: On the eve of the annual Maywood soapbox derby, a sudden rainstorm soaks Olivia cardboard car and completely ruins it. Never one to throw in the towel, Olivia turns Perry’s doghouse into a racecar and triumphantly wins the race – with Perry as her copilot!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When a beautiful butterfly emerges from the chrysalis in Ian’s butterfly terrarium, Olivia begs him to let her take it to school for Show & Tell. He finally agrees, but while showing and telling, the butterfly escapes and flies away! Olivia, donning a flower-shaped balloon hat, sets out to find it.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: The annual town dance competition is coming up, and Olivia is determined to put an end to the reigning champs’ (“The Prancer Dancers”) winning streak. With some help from Grandma, she forms her own rag-tag dance troupe, and learns a thing or two about dancing for the pure joy of it!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After Olivia and Dad spend an afternoon reading superhero comic books, a toy of William’s suddenly goes missing! Could it be the evil doings of some evil super villain? To get William’s toy back, Olivia recruits her friends to form her own crimesolving, superhero team!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Substitute Gargoyle ‐ Casper accidentally breaks a Gargoyle’s ear, and the Gargoyle jumps on the opportunity by faking so he doesn’t have to work anymore! The headmasters make Casper take the Gargoyle’s place while it is convalescing, and ends up doing all sorts of boring chores while the gargoyle takes it real easy. On top of that Ra and Mantha are forced to attend the smallest requests and they’re furious, it’s clear he’s faking everything and is the laziest lump of stone in the world. Casper and his friends now have to prove the fakery and get themselves out of being substitute gargoyles! Ship in a Bottle ‐ Casper has built a model of Cappy’s ship inside a bottle for a school competition. Thatch steals it and discovers that the bottle is actually magical: with is he can control Cappy’s pirate galleon like a magical remote control. The boat is shaken in all directions and ends up being uncontrollably projected towards Deedstown. Casper must break the spell and save the boat from a disaster.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Jack out of the Box ‐ Jimmy asks Casper to come to a toy swap in town and Casper brings a jack‐in‐a‐box that he’s found in the Scare School attic. In fact the ‘Jack’ is a sneaky little character dead set on taking his revenge on Scare School for being locked away all these years.. The Jack first hypnotizes Jimmy, and then other Deedstown kids before taking his little army to Scare School in order to confront Alder & Dash. Will Casper manage to trap the Jack and get Jimmy out of danger? Casper Meets Super Choc ‐ A spaceship has crashed in the Forbidden Forest! A strange little boy wearing a mask comes out of it and introduces himself to Casper. He says his name is Super Choc, that he comes from another planet and that his dream is to study at Scare School, the good reputation of which has travelled all the way to his planet. Easier said than done! The little super‐hero flunks the admission test to Scare School, and with Thatch’s help he turns the teachers into chocolate statues and goes to Deedstown to spread terror! Casper must do everything he can to stop this evil duo and send this rebellious little super‐ hero back to his planet!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When the Dews' Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews’ progress, they feel like they’re failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. / When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! / The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but can’t find the time to practice.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. / Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. / When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.desc: When Grandma Templeton comes to stay, she forces Boss Baby into Tim's room but they struggle to be roommates, and meanwhile, Baby Corp's new CEO trusts Boss Baby with the new Stinkless Serum

programme.desc: When Dagur comes to Dragon's Edge looking for Heather, Hiccup tries to keep the two siblings apart by teaching Dagur the art of Dragon Riding.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: Grug convinces The Croods to go on vacation, and they find a new family, The Broods, who live in a solitary utopia too good to be true/The Croods must escape and warn Ahhh! Valley before it's too late.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!
programme.desc: Poppy attempts to complete her Dad’s abandoned plans for the greatest sand castle of all time. Unfortunately, she didn’t take the tides into consideration. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business
programme.desc: On a dark and stormy night, Tim's fears of a local legend and Boss Baby's fear of a PuppyCo agent force the brothers to unite to stay safe as the house is infiltrated

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: The ultimate battle for existence begins! Armed with deadly aim, Roland the Last Gunslinger crosses realities to defend the mythical Dark Tower from the sinister Man in Black. If the tower falls, the universe crumbles into absolute darkness!

programme.title: Maximum Risk
programme.desc: In Maximum Risk, Jean-Claude Van Damme investigates his twin brother's death, leading him from France to New York alongside his brother's girlfriend (Natasha Henstridge) as they flee Russian mobsters and expose an international conspiracy.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: A modern action-thriller following Nick Randall, an ex-CIA operative turned bounty hunter who is hired to track down a ruthless international terrorist planning a devastating chemical attack on Los Angeles.

programme.title: 47 Ronin
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Moving to Thailand to work at an ice factory under a strict anti-violence vow, a young boy breaks his oath to confront a corrupt boss after his cousins disappear and he discovers the business is a front for drug smuggling.

programme.title: Enter The Game Of Death
programme.desc: In this martial arts adventure set on the eve of WWII, a skilled fighter is hired by Chinese espionage to fight his way up a multi-story tower and retrieve a top-secret military document detailing a planned invasion.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
